- **Do:** Name action-specific Form Requests with the action, model and Request suffix.
- **Flag when:** Flag when new action-specific request classes use inconsistent or ambiguous names.
- **Why:** A predictable name identifies both the validated resource and operation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class UserFormRequest extends FormRequest {}
```

After:
```php
class UpdateUserRequest extends FormRequest {}
```

#### Follow Eloquent schema conventions for new models unless domain or legacy constraints require overrides
- **Do:** Follow Eloquent schema conventions for new models unless domain or legacy constraints require overrides.
- **Flag when:** Flag when new tables, keys or timestamps add unnecessary model configuration.
- **Why:** Conventions reduce redundant metadata and make relationships easier to infer.
- **Enforced by:** partial: shift:workbench/remove-redundant-table-name

Before:
```php
protected $table = 'user_records'; protected $primaryKey = 'user_key';
```

After:
```php
// User uses users.id and conventional timestamps.
```

#### Start composable conditional model queries with query() and follow the established chain style
- **Do:** Start composable conditional model queries with query() and follow the established chain style.
- **Flag when:** Flag when conditional query construction repeatedly special-cases the initial static call or conflicts with local query style.
- **Why:** An explicit builder gives each conditional constraint a consistent starting point.
- **Enforced by:** partial: larastan:NoImplicitQueryBuilderCallRule, partial: rector:EloquentMagicMethodToQueryBuilderRector

Before:
```php
$query = User::where('active', true);
```

After:
```php
 $query = User::query()->when($activeOnly, fn ($q) => $q->where('active', true));
```

#### Nest API routes only when the parent-child relationship belongs in the resource contract
- **Do:** Nest API routes only when the parent-child relationship belongs in the resource contract.
- **Flag when:** Flag when deeply nested routes add parents that do not constrain lookup or authorization.
- **Why:** Meaningful nesting makes ownership explicit without unnecessary URL complexity.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::get('/users/{user}/teams/{team}/posts/{post}', $handler);
```

After:
```php
Route::get('/posts/{post}', $handler);
```

#### Use when() for optional query constraints when it keeps composition clear
- **Do:** Use when() for optional query constraints when it keeps composition clear.
- **Flag when:** Flag when conditional query construction duplicates builder branches or obscures the fluent query.
- **Why:** Conditional chaining keeps related predicates together while preserving explicit conditions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
if ($activeOnly) { $query->where('active', true); }
```

After:
```php
$query->when($activeOnly, fn ($q) => $q->where('active', true));
```

#### Encapsulate a file model attachment through Laravel's Attachable contract
- **Do:** Encapsulate a file model attachment through Laravel's Attachable contract.
- **Flag when:** Flag when mailables repeat storage-path knowledge for a model representing an attachment.
- **Why:** The model can own attachment metadata while mailables attach it through one contract.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$mail->attachFromStorageDisk($file->disk, $file->path);
```

After:
```php
class Document extends Model implements Attachable { public function toMailAttachment(): Attachment { return Attachment::fromStorageDisk($this->disk, $this->path); } }
```

#### Extract large coherent code blocks into small named functions
- **Do:** Extract large coherent code blocks into small named functions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a method mixes several responsibilities that can be named and reused independently.
- **Why:** Named functions make intent and control flow easier to review.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function handle() { /* validate, calculate, persist, notify in one long block */ }
```

After:
```php
public function handle() { $data = $this->validateInput(); $this->persist($data); $this->notify(); }
```

#### Install API and broadcasting scaffolding only when the application needs those features
- **Do:** Install API and broadcasting scaffolding only when the application needs those features.
- **Flag when:** Flag when unused generated routes, providers or dependencies are added without a feature requirement.
- **Why:** Optional scaffolding should reflect actual application capabilities.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Run every install:* command for a basic web app.
```

After:
```php
// Run php artisan install:api when implementing API authentication.
```

#### Use whereRelation() for a single simple related-column condition
- **Do:** Use whereRelation() for a single simple related-column condition.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a whereHas closure contains only one simple where predicate.
- **Why:** The concise relation filter makes a simple condition easier to read.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Post::whereHas('comments', fn ($q) => $q->where('approved', true))->get();
```

After:
```php
Post::whereRelation('comments', 'approved', true)->get();
```

#### Omit redundant asc arguments in conventional query ordering
- **Do:** Omit redundant asc arguments in conventional query ordering.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an orderBy call redundantly specifies the default ascending direction under the project style.
- **Why:** Omitting the default shortens a simple query without changing its behavior.
- **Enforced by:** shift:workbench/streamline-order-methods

Before:
```php
User::orderBy('name', 'asc');
```

After:
```php
User::orderBy('name');
```

#### Use model broadcasting for events whose sole purpose is exposing model lifecycle changes
- **Do:** Use model broadcasting for events whose sole purpose is exposing model lifecycle changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when custom event classes only repeat model created/updated/deleted notifications.
- **Why:** Built-in lifecycle broadcasting removes repetitive event plumbing.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Several identical UserCreated/UserUpdated broadcast event classes.
```

After:
```php
class User extends Model { use BroadcastsEvents; public function broadcastOn(string $event): array { return [$this]; } }
```

#### Use Blade use directives for class-only imports
- **Do:** Use Blade use directives for class-only imports.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Blade PHP block exists solely to import a class.
- **Why:** A dedicated directive makes the template dependency clear.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
@php use App\Models\Flight; @endphp
```

After:
```php
@use('App\Models\Flight')
```

#### Name listeners after the action they perform
- **Do:** Name listeners after the action they perform.
- **Flag when:** Flag when listener names fail to identify their response to an event.
- **Why:** Action names make event-to-effect mappings easier to understand.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class PodcastListener {}
```

After:
```php
class SendPodcastNotification {}
```

#### Declare a precise array return contract for model casts()
- **Do:** Declare a precise array return contract for model casts().
- **Flag when:** Flag when cast declarations lack array return types or use dynamic shapes analysis cannot infer.
- **Why:** A precise cast map helps analysis infer model attribute types.
- **Enforced by:** partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Methods\MissingMethodReturnTypehintRule

Before:
```php
protected function casts() { return ['active' => 'boolean']; }
```

After:
```php
/** @return array{active: 'boolean'} */
protected function casts(): array { return ['active' => 'boolean']; }
```

#### Honor the configured guard and user provider in reusable user lookups
- **Do:** In reusable authentication or user-resolution code, obtain the intended guard and its configured provider instead of assuming App\Models\User. Use provider credential lookup/validation; obtain a model class only for Eloquent providers, and batch Eloquent user-display lookups where supported.
- **Flag when:** Flag package/authentication infrastructure that queries a hard-coded User model even though another guard, Eloquent model or custom UserProvider can be configured.
- **Why:** Provider-aware consumers preserve custom authentication storage and model configurations without duplicating authentication logic.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$user = User::where('email', $credentials['email'])->first();
```

After:
```php
$provider = Auth::guard($guardName)->getProvider();
$user = $provider->retrieveByCredentials($credentials);
$valid = $user !== null && $provider->validateCredentials($user, $credentials);
```

#### Equip the configured user model for each enabled Fortify authentication feature
- **Do:** When enabling Fortify two-factor authentication, add TwoFactorAuthenticatable to the configured authenticatable model. For passkeys, satisfy the installed Fortify PasskeyUser contract, normally with PasskeyAuthenticatable; add MustVerifyEmail when email verification is enabled.
- **Flag when:** Flag an enabled Fortify feature whose actual user model lacks its required behavior or contract, including installations using a non-default authenticatable model.
- **Why:** Feature routes and actions depend on model methods and relationships supplied by those traits or equivalent contract implementations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class User extends Authenticatable {} // Fortify two-factor feature enabled
```

After:
```php
class User extends Authenticatable { use \Laravel\Fortify\TwoFactorAuthenticatable; }
```

#### Replace Pulse user resolution through its ResolvesUsers contract
- **Do:** When Pulse user identifiers or display data must support multiple authenticatable model types or custom storage, implement Laravel\Pulse\Contracts\ResolvesUsers and bind that resolver through the container instead of assuming the default user model.
- **Flag when:** Flag a custom Pulse user-display integration that hard-codes a single User model or bypasses the key/load/find contract needed to resolve the recorded identities.
- **Why:** A single explicit user resolver keeps recorded IDs and displayed users consistent for nonstandard authentication configurations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Dashboard code directly queries App\Models\User despite multiple authenticatable model types.
```

After:
```php
$this->app->singleton(\Laravel\Pulse\Contracts\ResolvesUsers::class, CustomPulseUsers::class);
```

#### Make package installation commands repeat-safe and explicit about optional setup
- **Do:** Have package installers detect existing files, environment keys and registrations so rerunning setup does not duplicate or silently overwrite them. Use clear Laravel Prompts confirmations for optional setup in interactive runs and explicit options/defaults for automation.
- **Flag when:** Flag an installer that appends duplicate env keys or registrations, overwrites customized files on rerun, or assumes an interactive terminal for optional changes.
- **Why:** Repeat-safe installation preserves host customization and lets failed or partially completed setup be resumed predictably.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
File::append(base_path('.env'), "\nREVERB_PORT=8080\n"); // repeated on every install
```

After:
```php
// Add only missing env keys and provider/routes registrations; ask before optional setup and support noninteractive flags.
```

#### Report the Throwable object rather than logging only its message
- **Do:** When an operational exception must be recorded, call report($exception), or pass the Throwable under the exception context key to the logger, instead of logging only getMessage().
- **Flag when:** Flag exception logging that discards the Throwable object and thereby loses its stack, class or Telescope exception classification.
- **Why:** The structured exception preserves stack information and lets exception-aware log handlers and Telescope recognize the error.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Log::error($exception->getMessage());
```

After:
```php
report($exception);
// Or: Log::error('Import failed', ['exception' => $exception]);
```

#### Use Pennant bulk updates for already-stored scope values
- **Do:** When activating or deactivating a feature for all scopes whose values are already stored, use Pennant activateForEveryone()/deactivateForEveryone() instead of loading and updating each user. Update the feature definition as well when unresolved or future scopes must receive the same decision.
- **Flag when:** Flag an application-wide stored-feature update that loops over hydrated users, or a rollout that assumes the bulk stored-value update also changes the resolver for scopes with no stored value.
- **Why:** Bulk storage updates avoid per-user work while distinguishing existing assignments from future feature resolution.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
User::all()->each(fn ($user) => Feature::for($user)->activate('new-api'));
```

After:
```php
Feature::activateForEveryone('new-api'); // also update its definition for unresolved scopes
```

#### Keep Eloquent primary and notifiable keys scalar
- **Do:** Keep Eloquent primary keys and database-notification notifiable identities as supported string or integer values; convert domain identifier objects at the persistence boundary. For routeNotificationFor* methods, return the type supported by the selected channel, such as a mail recipient array or a SlackRoute object.
- **Flag when:** Flag an unsupported identifier object returned as an Eloquent primary key or database-notification identity. Flag a notification route only when its value violates that channel's supported routing contract; allow documented array and object routes.
- **Why:** Lookup, serialization, collection dictionaries and package integrations assume scalar-compatible keys.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$model->setAttribute($model->getKeyName(), new AccountId($uuid)); // unsupported model key object
```

After:
```php
class Account extends \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
{
    use \Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;

    public function routeNotificationForMail(\Illuminate\Notifications\Notification $notification): array|string
    {
        return [$this->email => $this->name]; // Supported mail recipient array.
    }
}

$model->setAttribute($model->getKeyName(), (string) $accountId); // Scalar primary key.
```

#### Emit semantic domain events where the domain change occurs
- **Do:** When a side effect represents a particular domain operation, dispatch its named event from that operation with required original values. Use generic observers for true lifecycle invariants rather than inferring every business operation from dirty fields.
- **Flag when:** Flag a domain-specific email-change reaction that guesses intent and original recipient information from a generic model observer.
- **Why:** The initiating operation knows the event meaning and pre-change values explicitly.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// A generic UserObserver tries to infer all email-change workflows after persistence.
```

After:
```php
$original = $user->email;
$user->changeEmail($newEmail);
UserEmailAddressChanged::dispatch($user, $original);
```

#### Keep attribute conversion free of external side effects
- **Do:** Keep Eloquent accessor/mutator conversion focused on values. Perform file writes, remote calls and other external side effects in an explicit operation or appropriate lifecycle handler.
- **Flag when:** Flag a model getter or setter that creates/deletes files or mutates an external service simply because the attribute is accessed or assigned.
- **Why:** Accessors can run during serialization and repeated reads; side effects become surprising and hard to retry.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return Attribute::make(get: fn ($value) => Storage::put('seen.txt', $value));
```

After:
```php
return Attribute::make(get: fn ($value) => normalizeDisplayValue($value));
```

#### Keep model table identity separate from connection and prefix configuration
- **Do:** Configure the database connection through model connection metadata and connection table prefixes through database configuration. Do not concatenate a connection name or configured prefix into the model table property. Preserve legitimate database-schema-qualified table names when needed.
- **Flag when:** Flag a model table value containing a Laravel connection name or duplicating the connection configured prefix.
- **Why:** Connection selection and grammar prefixing are separate mechanisms from table naming.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected $table = 'reporting.prefix_orders'; // reporting is a connection name
```

After:
```php
protected $connection = 'reporting';
protected $table = 'orders'; // prefix belongs in connection config
```

#### Keep lazy-loading violations visible when replacing exceptions with a custom handler
- **Do:** Keep lazy-loading violations visible when replacing exceptions with a custom handler.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom lazy-loading violation handler silently suppresses all violations.
- **Why:** Logging or reporting preserves the development feedback that the guard is intended to provide.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Model::handleLazyLoadingViolationUsing(fn ($model, $relation) => null);
```

After:
```php
Model::handleLazyLoadingViolationUsing(fn ($model, $relation) => logger()->warning("Lazy relation: {$relation}"));
```

#### Use chunkById() or lazyById() when writes change the rows matching an iteration query
- **Do:** Use chunkById() or lazyById() when writes change the rows matching an iteration query.
- **Flag when:** Flag when offset-based chunk iteration updates or deletes records so later pages shift.
- **Why:** Stable key progression prevents rows from being skipped as the matching set changes.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
User::where('active', false)->chunk(100, fn ($rows) => $rows->each->update(['active' => true]));
```

After:
```php
User::where('active', false)->chunkById(100, fn ($rows) => $rows->each->update(['active' => true]));
```

- **Do:** Avoid redundant casts for conventional created_at and updated_at timestamps.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a model declares default timestamp casts without changing their behavior.
- **Why:** Eloquent already converts conventional timestamps; redundant declarations obscure intentional overrides.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected function casts(): array { return ['created_at' => 'datetime']; }
```

After:
```php
// Rely on Eloquent timestamps unless an immutable or custom format is required.
```

#### Keep HTML data attributes small and avoid embedding full model payloads
- **Do:** Keep HTML data attributes small and avoid embedding full model payloads.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a template serializes a large or sensitive model into a data attribute.
- **Why:** Small explicit values reduce payload size and accidental field exposure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<div data-user="{{ $user->toJson() }}"></div>
```

After:
```php
<div data-user-id="{{ $user->id }}"></div>
```

#### Use wire:model.live when a Livewire input must update the server as the user edits
- **Do:** Use wire:model.live when a Livewire input must update the server as the user edits.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code expects immediate server updates from plain deferred wire:model.
- **Why:** Explicit live binding aligns update timing with the UI behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:


After:
```php

```

#### Use the correctly cased model name in Folio model-bound filenames
- **Do:** Use the correctly cased model name in Folio model-bound filenames.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Folio filename uses lowercase [user] while the page expects a User model.
- **Why:** Folio binding syntax distinguishes model names from plain route parameters.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php

```

After:
```php
// pages/users/[User].blade.php expects User
```

#### Centralize data-driven native UI colors in one enum or model method
- **Do:** Centralize data-driven native UI colors in one enum or model method.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the same domain status maps to inconsistent color values in multiple UI definitions.
- **Why:** One mapping keeps domain styling consistent when statuses change.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$color = $order->paid ? 'green' : 'red';
```

After:
```php
enum Status: string { case Paid = 'paid'; public function color(): string { return 'green'; } }
```

#### Centralize custom route-parameter resolution in an explicit route binding
- **Do:** Centralize custom route-parameter resolution in an explicit route binding.
- **Flag when:** Flag when controllers repeat nonstandard resolution for the same route parameter.
- **Why:** A binding gives custom lookup one consistent entry point and missing-value policy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function show($entry) { $entry = resolveEntry($entry); }
```

After:
```php

```

#### Keep large model payloads out of Livewire public state and resolve authorized models on demand
- **Do:** Keep large model payloads out of Livewire public state and resolve authorized models on demand.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a component stores a large model graph in public properties for simple form state.
- **Why:** Small explicit state reduces serialization work and limits unintended exposure; IDs must still be authorized on every action.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php

```

After:
```php
public int $userId; public string $name;
// Resolve and authorize the user when needed.
```

#### Keep development-only diagnostic tools in require-dev
- **Do:** Keep development-only diagnostic tools in require-dev.
- **Flag when:** Flag when local-only Telescope or Clockwork packages are mandatory production dependencies.
- **Why:** Development dependency boundaries keep production deployments focused on runtime needs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Create related records through the owning relationship when it defines their foreign key
- **Do:** Create related records through the owning relationship when it defines their foreign key.
- **Flag when:** Flag when callers manually duplicate parent-key assignment for straightforward related creation.
- **Why:** Relationship creation applies the configured key consistently.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Comment::create(['post_id' => $post->id, 'body' => $body]);
```

After:
```php
$post->comments()->create(['body' => $body]);
```

#### Name model-specific seeders with the singular model name and Seeder suffix
- **Do:** Name model-specific seeders with the singular model name and Seeder suffix.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a new model-specific seeder uses inconsistent naming.
- **Why:** Predictable names make fixture ownership obvious.


After:

#### Filter non-local Telescope recording to diagnostically useful entries
- **Do:** Filter non-local Telescope recording to diagnostically useful entries.
- **Flag when:** Flag when non-local telemetry captures every request and query despite a narrower diagnostic need.
- **Why:** Selective recording reduces storage, overhead and unnecessary sensitive data capture.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Bound response content captured by Telescope
- **Do:** Bound response content captured by Telescope.
- **Flag when:** Flag when telemetry can retain arbitrarily large response bodies.
- **Why:** A configured size limit prevents unexpectedly large diagnostic payloads.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Define stable serialization for custom Pennant scope objects
- **Do:** Define stable serialization for custom Pennant scope objects.
- **Flag when:** Flag when feature storage receives unsupported objects without an explicit stable scope identifier.
- **Why:** Stable scope serialization prevents ambiguous or inconsistent feature identities.

Before:
```php

```

```php
// Implement the supported Pennant scope serialization contract using a stable ID.
```

#### Use request->user() when a request object is already available
- **Do:** Use request->user() when a request object is already available.
- **Flag when:** Flag when request-scoped code redundantly resolves the same user through global auth helpers.
- **Why:** The request accessor makes the dependency and nullable user explicit.

```php

```

After:

#### Use ScopedBy for equivalent class-based global scope registration when adopting model attributes
- **Do:** Use ScopedBy for equivalent class-based global scope registration when adopting model attributes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when attribute-based models register equivalent scope classes imperatively in scattered boot code.
- **Why:** Declarative registration makes universal query constraints visible on the model.


#### Prefer composition for reusable model/controller behavior over deep custom base-class hierarchies
- **Do:** Prefer composition for reusable model/controller behavior over deep custom base-class hierarchies.
- **Flag when:** Flag when unrelated models or controllers inherit behavior solely through increasingly broad shared bases.
- **Why:** Composition limits coupling and makes dependencies explicit.
- **Enforced by:** partial: shift:public/linter/composition

Before:
```php

```


#### Bound similarity search and apply visibility constraints before retrieving context
- **Do:** Bound model similarity searches with the limit argument of SimilaritySearch::usingModel and apply tenant/visibility restrictions through its query callback.
- **Flag when:** Flag unbounded or unauthorized similarity retrieval, or chained limit()/query() calls on the SimilaritySearch tool.
- **Why:** Limits and scoped predicates keep retrieved context relevant and authorized.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
SimilaritySearch::usingModel(Document::class, 'embedding');
```

After:
```php
SimilaritySearch::usingModel(
    model: Document::class,
    column: 'embedding',
    limit: 10,
    query: fn ($q) => $q->where('published', true),
);
```

#### Keep incoming route-model lookup and generated URLs aligned on the intended route key
- **Do:** Keep incoming route-model lookup and generated URLs aligned on the intended route key.
- **Flag when:** Flag when URL generation uses a slug while route binding still looks up an ID or vice versa.
- **Why:** Aligned keys avoid broken links and unintended lookup behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php

```

After:
```php
Route::get('/posts/{post:slug}', $handler); // ensure generated parameters use slug too
```

#### Keep sortable UUIDv7 model keys unless another UUID format is required
- **Do:** Keep sortable UUIDv7 model keys unless another UUID format is required.
- **Flag when:** Flag when new UUID model keys are switched to unordered UUIDs without a domain requirement.
- **Why:** Sortable identifiers improve index locality relative to random identifiers.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Override HasUuids::newUniqueId with a random UUID unnecessarily.
```

After:
```php
class Order extends Model { use HasUuids; }
```

#### Use fail-on-missing retrieval when an absent required record should return 404
- **Do:** Use fail-on-missing retrieval when an absent required record should return 404.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a required record is fetched with first/find then dereferenced without a null policy.
- **Why:** Failing retrieval gives the endpoint a clear missing-resource response.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php

```

After:
```php
$post = Post::findOrFail($id); return $post->title;
```

#### Let Eloquent maintain ordinary create/update timestamps
- **Do:** Let Eloquent maintain ordinary create/update timestamps.
- **Flag when:** Flag when routine model saves manually set conventional timestamps without a historical-data requirement.
- **Why:** Automatic timestamps avoid duplicate clock and update logic.
- **Enforced by:** manual

```php

```

After:
```php

```

#### Use per-model writes when lifecycle events or cleanup hooks are required
- **Do:** Use per-model writes when lifecycle events or cleanup hooks are required.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a mass update/delete/prune is expected to run individual model observers or cleanup hooks.
- **Why:** Query-level writes do not retrieve each model and skip per-model lifecycle events.
- **Enforced by:** manual

```php

```

After:
```php

```

#### Provide a deleted_at column for every model using SoftDeletes
- **Do:** Provide a deleted_at column for every model using SoftDeletes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a soft-deleting model table lacks the configured deletion timestamp column.
- **Why:** Soft deletion needs persistent deletion state for its default scope and lifecycle.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class Post extends Model { use SoftDeletes; } // table lacks deleted_at
```

After:
```php
$table->softDeletes();
```

#### Group substantial sets of model lifecycle listeners in an observer
- **Do:** Group substantial sets of model lifecycle listeners in an observer.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a model or provider accumulates many interleaved event handlers for one model.
- **Why:** An observer gives related lifecycle behavior one discoverable home.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Many model event closures spread across providers.
```

After:


#### Use withWhereHas() when parent filtering and eager loading must use the same relation predicate
- **Do:** Use withWhereHas() when parent filtering and eager loading must use the same relation predicate.
- **Flag when:** Flag when whereHas and with duplicate a predicate that can drift.
- **Why:** One predicate keeps selected parents and loaded children consistent.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php

```

#### Enable automatic relationship eager loading deliberately and verify its query behavior
- **Do:** Enable automatic relationship eager loading deliberately and verify its query behavior.
- **Flag when:** Flag when automatic eager loading is enabled globally without considering unexpected relation reads or query cost.
- **Why:** Automatic loading can batch relation access, but explicit loading gives clearer query ownership; the feature remains version-sensitive.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// No automatic batching: repeated optional relation reads may issue N+1 queries.
```

```php
Model::automaticallyEagerLoadRelationships(); // deliberate policy; verify representative queries
```

#### Keep attribute/cast names distinct from relationship names
- **Do:** Keep attribute/cast names distinct from relationship names.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a cast or attribute shadows a model relationship.

- **Do:** Configure primary-key types through key metadata rather than an ordinary attribute cast.

- **Do:** Keep UTC ISO-8601 date serialization unless the API explicitly requires another format.

- **Do:** Provide array and JSON serialization for custom cast value objects exposed through models.

- **Do:** Extract substantial reused query transformations into focused query objects and distinguish execution from mutation.

Before:
```php
// Team-owned route bypasses starter-kit team resolution.
```

After:
```php
// Use {current_team}/{team} routes with the kit membership middleware.
```

#### Handle nullable feature scopes in guest-capable Pennant workflows
- **Do:** Handle nullable feature scopes in guest-capable Pennant workflows.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a feature resolver assumes an authenticated model on guest requests.
- **Why:** Explicit null handling avoids errors and defines guest feature behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Feature::define('flag', fn (User $user) => $user->is_admin);
```

After:
```php
Feature::define('flag', fn (?User $user) => $user?->is_admin ?? false);
```

#### Generate a fresh Telescope CSP nonce for each request
- **Do:** Generate a fresh Telescope CSP nonce for each request.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a CSP nonce is fixed or reused across requests.
- **Why:** A request-specific nonce preserves the intended script authorization boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Schedule Telescope entry pruning according to telemetry retention
- **Do:** Schedule Telescope entry pruning according to telemetry retention.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Telescope entries grow without a scheduled retention cleanup.
- **Why:** Bounded diagnostic retention controls storage growth.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Eager-load feature values before iterating over many Pennant scopes
- **Do:** Eager-load feature values before iterating over many Pennant scopes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a loop queries feature storage separately for each model scope.
- **Why:** Batch loading avoids feature-check N+1 queries.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
foreach ($users as $user) { Feature::for($user)->active('flag'); }
```

After:
```php
Feature::for($users)->load(['flag']);
```

#### Preload the initial Inertia page component as a Vite entry when the build exposes page entries
- **Do:** When the Vite build exposes page entries, preload the initial Inertia page using the actual entry paths and filename casing; use the Laravel 13 starter-kit layout for a new application.
- **Flag when:** Flag an avoidable initial page-component fetch or a Blade Vite directive that references outdated entry filenames or page-directory casing.
- **Why:** Preloading the current page removes an extra initial navigation round trip.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
@vite(['resources/css/app.css', 'resources/js/app.ts']) // page entry omitted
```

After:
```php
@vite(['resources/css/app.css', 'resources/js/app.ts', "resources/js/pages/{$page['component']}.vue"])
```

#### Extract repeated form field markup into components that forward input attributes
- **Do:** Extract repeated form field markup into components that forward input attributes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when repeated field components drop wire:model or other caller attributes.
- **Why:** Shared markup needs to preserve the underlying input binding contract.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<input type="text"> // component ignores attributes
```

After:
```php
@props(['label']) <label>{{ $label }}<input {{ $attributes }}></label>
```

#### Load Larastan's extension in PHPStan configuration
- **Do:** Load Larastan's extension in PHPStan configuration.
- **Flag when:** Flag when PHPStan analyzes Eloquent code without Laravel-aware model and builder extensions.
- **Why:** Framework-aware analysis understands Eloquent magic and reduces unchecked gaps.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// phpstan.neon lacks Laravel extension.
```

After:
```php
// includes: - vendor/larastan/larastan/extension.neon
```

#### Represent closed domain value sets with backed PHP enums
- **Do:** Represent closed domain value sets with backed PHP enums.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a fixed set of domain states/providers is repeated as unrelated string constants.
- **Why:** Enums constrain valid values and collect associated behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
const STATUS_DRAFT = 'draft';
```

After:
```php
enum Status: string { case Draft = 'draft'; case Published = 'published'; }
```

#### Request only the OAuth scopes required by the integration and declare them explicitly
- **Do:** Request only the OAuth scopes required by the integration and declare them explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when integration code relies on provider defaults or requests unrelated privileges.
- **Why:** Explicit scopes make required access reviewable.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Socialite::driver('provider')->redirect(); // relies on unsuitable defaults
```

After:
```php
Socialite::driver('provider')->setScopes(['required:read'])->redirect();
```

#### Qualify tenant-filter columns with their model table
- **Do:** Qualify tenant-filter columns with their model table.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a tenant scope uses an unqualified tenant_id in a joined query with multiple matching columns.
- **Why:** Qualified predicates avoid ambiguity and constrain the intended table.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$builder->where('tenant_id', $id);
```

After:
```php
$builder->where($model->qualifyColumn('tenant_id'), $id);
```

#### Give custom inputs a named native value when using Inertia Form serialization
- **Do:** When Inertia Form gathers controls from the HTML form, ensure a custom non-native input contributes its current value through a named native control, such as a synchronized hidden input, or an explicit supported form transform.
- **Flag when:** Flag a component that displays and updates an OTP/custom value in reactive state but contributes no named form control or transform entry to the Inertia Form submission.
- **Why:** A reactive component value alone is not necessarily a successful HTML form control, so the server can otherwise receive an empty or missing field.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<Form><InputOTP v-model="code" /></Form>
```

After:
```php
<Form><InputOTP v-model="code" /><input type="hidden" name="code" :value="code" /></Form>
```

#### Persist significant domain-event history when traceability and replay are required
- **Do:** For business occurrences requiring traceability or deliberate replay, represent them as named domain events and persist an identifiable event history with the data needed to reconstruct the intended processing.
- **Flag when:** Flag a workflow with explicit replay/audit requirements that records only an opaque final status or transient notifications, with no usable history of the significant occurrences.
- **Why:** A durable event history explains what happened and supports controlled reconstruction or retry of the required processing.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Auction status changes, but required occurrence/replay history is discarded.
```

After:
```php
// Record AuctionEnded with the auction identity, occurrence time and required event data before deliberate replay/projection handling.
```

#### Remove casts whose input already has the required type
- **Do:** Remove a scalar cast when static analysis proves the expression already has that type and no explicit boundary convention requires the cast.
- **Flag when:** Flag casts that cannot change the value or type and merely obscure an already typed expression.
- **Why:** Redundant conversions add noise and can hide uncertainty about the real type boundary.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Cast\UselessCastRule

Before:
```php
function countItems(int $count): int { return (int) $count; }
```

After:
```php
function countItems(int $count): int { return $count; }
```

#### Retain Larastan migration caching when the analysis cache is writable
- **Do:** Keep enableMigrationCache enabled for ordinary analysis. Disable it deliberately when the temp directory cannot be written or a fresh parse is required, rather than rescanning unchanged migrations on every run.
- **Flag when:** Flag an unexplained disablement of migration caching in repeated analysis with a writable cache directory.
- **Why:** Caching parsed migrations and schema dumps avoids repeated model-property inference work.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Require deleted state for operations limited to trashed models
- **Do:** For restore or other deleted-only routes, resolve through onlyTrashed() or explicitly reject a bound model that is not trashed. Merely enabling withTrashed() does not impose a deleted-only constraint.
- **Flag when:** Flag a deleted-only operation that accepts an ordinary active model through withTrashed() binding.
- **Why:** withTrashed() includes both active and deleted records.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$article = Article::withTrashed()->findOrFail($id);
$article->restore();
```

After:
```php
$article = Article::onlyTrashed()->findOrFail($id);
$article->restore();
```

#### Declare domain event payloads as explicit typed properties
- **Do:** Use focused event classes with explicit typed properties for the actors, entities and values listeners require, instead of loosely structured arrays with undocumented keys.
- **Flag when:** Flag domain event consumers depending on undocumented array keys or inconsistent value types.
- **Why:** Typed payload contracts make event producers and consumers agree on the data being exchanged.
- **Enforced by:** partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Properties\MissingPropertyTypehintRule

Before:
```php
event('question.answered', ['user' => $userId, 'question' => $questionId, 'answer' => $answerId]);
```

After:
```php
event(new QuestionAnswered(userId: $userId, questionId: $questionId, answerId: $answerId));
```

#### Load initial-viewport and LCP images eagerly
- **Do:** Avoid lazy loading images needed in the initial viewport, especially the likely largest-contentful-paint image. Override component lazy defaults for those images.
- **Flag when:** Flag a hero/LCP image marked loading="lazy" or deferred by a default image component.
- **Why:** Deferring discovery/loading of visible images can delay the page principal content.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<img src="/hero.jpg" loading="lazy" alt="Main product">
```

After:
```php
<img src="/hero.jpg" loading="eager" alt="Main product">
```

#### Order parents by a single related value without multiplying parent rows
- **Do:** Order parents by a single related value without multiplying parent rows.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a direct has-many join used for sorting returns duplicate parent rows or breaks pagination.
- **Why:** A correlated scalar subquery preserves one result row per parent.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
User::join('logins', 'users.id', 'logins.user_id')->orderByDesc('logins.created_at')->get();
```

After:
```php
User::orderByDesc(Login::select('created_at')->whereColumn('user_id', 'users.id')->latest()->limit(1))->get();
```

#### Use explicit table names instead of evolving application models in migrations
- **Do:** Use explicit table names instead of evolving application models in migrations.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a historical migration depends on current model scopes, casts, events or table resolution.
- **Why:** Migrations must remain reproducible after application models change.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
User::whereNull('name')->update(['name' => 'Unknown']);
```

After:
```php
DB::table('users')->whereNull('name')->update(['name' => 'Unknown']);
```

#### Model a domain transition as a resource controller when store/destroy naturally express it
- **Do:** Model a domain transition as a resource controller when store/destroy naturally express it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a controller accumulates custom actions for transitions that have clear resource semantics.
- **Why:** Focused resource controllers make routes and authorization easier to understand.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::post('/podcasts/{podcast}/publish', [PodcastController::class, 'publish']);
```

After:
```php
Route::post('/podcasts/{podcast}/publication', [PublishedPodcastController::class, 'store']);
```

#### Use the established scope or custom-builder pattern for reusable query behavior
- **Do:** Use the established scope or custom-builder pattern for reusable query behavior.
- **Flag when:** Flag when new reusable predicates introduce a competing query abstraction without a distinct need.
- **Why:** A predictable query API makes reusable filters easier to locate.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Existing scopes are bypassed by a new duplicate query abstraction.
$posts = (new PublishedPostsQuery)->get();
```

After:
```php
$posts = Post::query()->published()->get();
```

#### Bind Inertia form controls to useForm state and prevent native submission
- **Do:** Bind Inertia form controls to useForm state and prevent native submission.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a useForm view submits natively or controls do not update the submitted form object.
- **Why:** Bound state and prevented submission preserve Inertia validation and request behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<form><input name="name"></form>
```

After:
```php
<form @submit.prevent="form.post('/users')"><input v-model="form.name"></form>
```

#### Use wire:model.deep in Livewire 4 when binding depends on child events
- **Do:** Use wire:model.deep in Livewire 4 when binding depends on child events.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Livewire 4 control expects bubbled child events to update a plain wire:model binding.
- **Why:** Livewire 4 requires the deep modifier for this event behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<div wire:model="choice"><input></div>
```

After:
```php
<div wire:model.deep="choice"><input></div>
```

#### Store a state-change timestamp when the time of the transition is meaningful
- **Do:** Store a state-change timestamp when the time of the transition is meaningful.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a boolean state flag discards a required publication or activation time.
- **Why:** A nullable timestamp records both state and transition time.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$table->boolean('is_published')->default(false);
```

After:
```php
$table->timestamp('published_at')->nullable();
```

#### Avoid repositories or wrappers that only forward Eloquent calls
- **Do:** Avoid repositories or wrappers that only forward Eloquent calls.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an abstraction exposes only pass-through query/find/create methods with no meaningful boundary.
- **Why:** Thin wrappers add maintenance without hiding real variation or domain behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function find($id) { return User::find($id); }
```

After:
```php
$user = User::find($id);
```

#### Schedule pruning for soft-deleted records that exceed the retention policy
- **Do:** Schedule pruning for soft-deleted records that exceed the retention policy.
- **Flag when:** Flag when soft-deleted records accumulate indefinitely despite an agreed deletion deadline.
- **Why:** A scheduled retention query bounds storage and enforces the deletion policy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// SoftDeletes with no retention cleanup.
```

After:
```php
public function prunable(): Builder { return static::onlyTrashed()->where('deleted_at', '<=', now()->subMonth()); }
// Schedule::command('model:prune')->daily();
```

#### Apply tenant isolation to every tenant-owned query in shared-table tenancy
- **Do:** Apply tenant isolation to every tenant-owned query in shared-table tenancy.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a tenant-owned model can be queried without the current tenant constraint.
- **Why:** A centralized tenant scope reduces cross-tenant data exposure; tenant context must be established and reset correctly.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Invoice::findOrFail($id); // no tenant boundary
```

After:
```php
// Invoice has a tenant global scope bound to the current team_id.
```

#### Implement the intended dependent-record behavior explicitly for soft deletion
- **Do:** Implement the intended dependent-record behavior explicitly for soft deletion.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code expects an SQL ON DELETE cascade to run when only deleted_at is updated.
- **Why:** Soft deletion is an UPDATE, so database delete cascades do not run; ordinary foreign-key integrity remains intact.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$parent->delete(); // assumes children are soft-deleted automatically
```

After:
```php
DB::transaction(function () use ($parent) { $parent->children()->eachById(fn ($child) => $child->delete()); $parent->delete(); });
```

#### Keep Telescope out of production when production diagnostics are served by dedicated monitoring
- **Do:** Keep Telescope out of production when production diagnostics are served by dedicated monitoring.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Telescope is deployed to production despite a local-only diagnostic policy.
- **Why:** Local-only installation avoids production collection overhead and sensitive telemetry exposure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Use SoftDeletes for recoverable deletion that should receive standard query scoping
- **Do:** Use SoftDeletes for recoverable deletion that should receive standard query scoping.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom archived_at deletion mechanism duplicates the built-in deleted_at lifecycle and filtering.
- **Why:** SoftDeletes provides consistent exclusion, restore and force-delete behavior; distinguish deletion from domain archival.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Manually add whereNull(archived_at) to every query.
```

After:
```php
class Post extends Model { use SoftDeletes; }
```

#### Use deferred wire:model when server work can wait until submission
- **Do:** Use deferred wire:model when server work can wait until submission.
- **Flag when:** Flag when inputs issue live requests although no interactive server result depends on each edit.
- **Why:** Deferred state avoids unnecessary network round trips.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<input wire:model.live="name">
```

After:
```php
<input wire:model="name">
```

#### Use model creation for seed data that requires casts, observers or lifecycle behavior
- **Do:** Use model creation for seed data that requires casts, observers or lifecycle behavior.
- **Flag when:** Flag when seeders bypass Eloquent even though required model behavior must run.
- **Why:** Model creation preserves the behavior expected by downstream data.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
DB::table('users')->insert($rows); // observer required
```

After:
```php
foreach ($rows as $row) { User::create($row); }
```

#### Keep reusable scopes composable and let callers choose query execution
- **Do:** Keep reusable scopes composable and let callers choose query execution.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a scope terminates the builder with get, first, paginate or count.
- **Why:** Composability lets one predicate serve lists, counts, pagination and batch tasks.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function scopeActive($q) { return $q->where('active', true)->get(); }
```

After:
```php
#[Scope] protected function active(Builder $q): void { $q->where('active', true); }
```

#### Use AsCollection when a JSON attribute is consumed through collection operations
- **Do:** Use AsCollection when a JSON attribute is consumed through collection operations.
- **Flag when:** Flag when callers repeatedly wrap the same decoded JSON attribute in collect.
- **Why:** A collection cast centralizes the expected collection interface.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
collect($user->options)->map($callback);
```

After:
```php
protected function casts(): array { return ['options' => AsCollection::class]; }
```

#### Scope identifier validation to the caller's allowed records
- **Do:** Scope identifier validation to the caller's allowed records.
- **Flag when:** Flag when exists validation accepts any record ID when only caller-owned records are valid.
- **Why:** Existence alone does not establish ownership or permission.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Rule::exists('projects', 'id');
```

After:
```php
Rule::exists('projects', 'id')->where('user_id', $request->user()->id);
```

#### Resolve passkeys through the authenticated user relationship
- **Do:** Resolve passkeys through the authenticated user relationship.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a passkey lookup accepts another user credential ID without ownership scoping.
- **Why:** Credential management must remain bound to the authenticated account.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$passkey = Passkey::findOrFail($id);
```

After:
```php
$passkey = $request->user()->passkeys()->findOrFail($id);
```

#### Instantiate unsaved models with new when no factory behavior is needed
- **Do:** Instantiate unsaved models with new when no factory behavior is needed.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Model::make obscures straightforward unsaved construction under the project style.
- **Why:** Direct construction makes the unsaved object intent explicit.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:NoModelMakeRule

Before:
```php
$user = User::make(['name' => $name]);
```

After:
```php
$user = new User(['name' => $name]);
```

#### Call parent::boot() when overriding model boot()
- **Do:** Call parent::boot() when overriding model boot().
- **Flag when:** Flag when an override skips the parent boot implementation.
- **Why:** Skipping the parent prevents Eloquent trait initialization and lifecycle setup.
- **Enforced by:** rector:AddParentBootToModelClassMethodRector

Before:
```php
protected static function boot() { static::creating($callback); }
```

After:
```php
protected static function boot(): void { parent::boot(); static::creating($callback); }
```

#### Use lowercase canonical PHP casts with one space before the operand
- **Do:** Use lowercase canonical PHP casts with one space before the operand.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code uses uppercase/alias casts, double negation for booleans or no space after a cast.
- **Why:** Consistent explicit casts clarify type conversion and conform to automated style rules.
- **Enforced by:** pint:cast_spaces, pint:lowercase_cast, pint:no_short_bool_cast, pint:short_scalar_cast

Before:
```php
$enabled = !!$value;
```

After:
```php
$enabled = (bool) $value;
```

#### Write the PHP scope-resolution operator without surrounding spaces
- **Do:** Write the PHP scope-resolution operator without surrounding spaces.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code contains whitespace around ::.
- **Why:** Consistent operator formatting keeps code compatible with the project style checks.
- **Enforced by:** pint:no_space_around_double_colon

Before:
```php
User :: query();
```

After:
```php
User::query();
```

#### Replace the removed unset cast with explicit null or unset as appropriate
- **Do:** Replace the removed unset cast with explicit null or unset as appropriate.
- **Flag when:** Flag when PHP code uses the removed (unset) cast.
- **Why:** The removed cast is incompatible with supported PHP versions.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Cast\UnsetCastRule, pint:no_unset_cast

Before:
```php
$value = (unset) $value;
```

After:
```php
$value = null;
```

#### Pass only string-convertible values to output and native string-conversion operations
- **Do:** Pass only string-convertible values to output and native string-conversion operations.
- **Flag when:** Flag when echo, print, interpolation or string-based native operations receive arrays or non-stringable objects.
- **Why:** Explicit conversion or field selection prevents runtime warnings and type errors.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Cast\EchoRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Cast\InvalidPartOfEncapsedStringRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Cast\PrintRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Functions\ImplodeParameterCastableToStringRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Functions\ParameterCastableToStringRule

Before:
```php
echo $user->roles;
```

After:
```php
echo $user->roles->pluck('name')->implode(', ');
```

#### Use conversions supported by the source and required target types
- **Do:** Use conversions supported by the source and required target types.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a cast or numeric native-function call receives a nonconvertible value.
- **Why:** Type-compatible conversions avoid runtime errors and misleading values.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Cast\InvalidCastRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Functions\ParameterCastableToNumberRule

Before:
```php
$amount = (int) $unknownObject;
```

After:
```php
$amount = (int) $validatedNumericString;
```

#### Use ObservedBy for equivalent observer registration when adopting model attributes
- **Do:** Use ObservedBy for equivalent observer registration when adopting model attributes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when attribute-based models retain scattered equivalent observer registration without a reason.
- **Why:** Model-local registration makes lifecycle ownership discoverable.
- **Enforced by:** shift:workbench/laravel-observedby-attribute

Before:
```php
User::observe(UserObserver::class);
```

After:
```php
#[ObservedBy([UserObserver::class])] class User extends Model {}
```

#### Replace removed legacy Laravel helpers, classes and method names with supported equivalents
- **Do:** Replace removed legacy Laravel helpers, classes and method names with supported equivalents.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Laravel 13 code references obsolete array_pluck, lists, withHidden or related removed symbols.
- **Why:** Removed APIs fail at runtime; replacements must preserve the original visibility and query behavior.
- **Enforced by:** partial: rector:RenameMethodRector, partial: rector:FuncCallToStaticCallRector, partial: rector:RenameClassRector

Before:
```php
$names = User::query()->lists('name');
```

After:
```php
$names = User::query()->pluck('name');
```

#### Count matching rows in SQL instead of hydrating models to count them
- **Do:** Count matching rows in SQL instead of hydrating models to count them.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a query loads every model solely for collection count.
- **Why:** A count query transfers one aggregate instead of all rows.
- **Enforced by:** partial: larastan:NoUnnecessaryCollectionCallRule

Before:
```php
$count = User::all()->count();
```

After:
```php
$count = User::count();
```

#### Configure provider model defaults centrally, including required defaults for compatible endpoints
- **Do:** Configure provider model defaults centrally, including required defaults for compatible endpoints.
- **Flag when:** Flag when calls duplicate model choices or use an openai-compatible provider without required task-model settings.
- **Why:** Central defaults make model selection explicit and prevent missing-model requests.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Repeat model strings across every call.
```

After:
```php
// config/ai.php: provider models.text.default and models.embeddings.default set to supported models.
```

#### Use enum backing values as PHP array keys
- **Do:** Use enum backing values as PHP array keys.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an array key is an enum object rather than an integer or string.
- **Why:** PHP arrays cannot use enum objects as keys.
- **Enforced by:** partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Arrays\InvalidKeyInArrayDimFetchRule, partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Arrays\InvalidKeyInArrayItemRule

Before:
```php
$models = [Lab::Gemini => 'model'];
```

After:
```php
$models = [Lab::Gemini->value => 'model'];
```

#### Compare model identity with is() or isNot() when table and connection matter
- **Do:** Compare model identity with is() or isNot() when table and connection matter.
- **Flag when:** Flag when model equality compares only IDs across potentially different tables or connections.
- **Why:** Eloquent identity includes primary key, table and connection.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$same = $first->id === $second->id;
```

After:
```php
$same = $first->is($second);
```

#### Name and reuse recurring constrained relationships
- **Do:** Name and reuse recurring constrained relationships.
- **Flag when:** Flag when callers repeat the same relationship predicate under several query paths.
- **Why:** A named relation centralizes a meaningful related subset.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$user->posts()->where('featured', true)->get();
```

After:
```php
public function featuredPosts(): HasMany { return $this->posts()->where('featured', true); }
```

#### Represent a true many-to-many association with an intermediate table
- **Do:** Represent a true many-to-many association with an intermediate table.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a single foreign key is used where each side can have multiple counterparts.
- **Why:** One foreign key cannot express independent multiple associations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$table->foreignId('user_id'); // roles shared by many users
```

After:
```php
// role_user has user_id and role_id with an appropriate unique/index constraint.
```

#### Enable pivot timestamps only with both created_at and updated_at columns present
- **Do:** Enable pivot timestamps only with both created_at and updated_at columns present.
- **Flag when:** Flag when withTimestamps is configured on a pivot table lacking either expected timestamp.
- **Why:** The relation writes both timestamps and needs a matching schema.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $this->belongsToMany(Role::class)->withTimestamps(); // pivot has no timestamps
```

After:
```php
// Pivot migration: $table->timestamps();
```

#### Enable incrementing keys on custom pivots whose table has an auto-increment primary key
- **Do:** Enable incrementing keys on custom pivots whose table has an auto-increment primary key.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom pivot has an auto-increment ID but remains configured as non-incrementing.
- **Why:** Correct key metadata lets Eloquent retrieve and track generated pivot IDs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class Membership extends Pivot {} // table has auto-increment id
```

After:
```php
#[Table(incrementing: true)] class Membership extends Pivot {}
```

#### Review loaded relationships as part of the model serialization exposure surface
- **Do:** Review loaded relationships as part of the model serialization exposure surface.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an endpoint serializes a model with sensitive loaded relations unintentionally included.
- **Why:** Loaded relations are recursively serialized unless visibility controls exclude them.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $user->load('privateNotes');
```

After:
```php
return new UserResource($user); // include only approved relation fields
```

#### Prefix Echo listeners with a dot for custom names and model broadcasts
- **Do:** Prefix Echo listeners with a dot for custom names and model broadcasts.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Echo namespaces an event name that is already fully specified by broadcastAs or model broadcasting.
- **Why:** The leading dot prevents an extra application namespace prefix.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Echo.private(channel).listen('UserUpdated', handler);
```

After:
```php
Echo.private(channel).listen('.UserUpdated', handler);
```

#### Cache immutable class metadata per class across model instances
- **Do:** Cache immutable class metadata per class across model instances.
- **Flag when:** Flag when reflection is repeated per instance despite identical class metadata.
- **Why:** A class-keyed static cache reuses immutable metadata without retaining request-specific model state.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Reflect the same class from every instance via instance-bound once().
```

After:
```php
static::$metadata[static::class] ??= (new ReflectionClass(static::class))->getAttributes();
```

#### Preserve Eloquent model construction and prefer initialization hooks over custom constructors
- **Do:** Preserve Eloquent model construction and prefer initialization hooks over custom constructors.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom constructor bypasses or conflicts with the parent model initialization lifecycle.
- **Why:** Eloquent construction handles booting, traits and attributes; trait initializers are safer for shared setup.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function __construct() { $this->options = []; }
```

After:
```php
trait HasOptions { public function initializeHasOptions(): void { $this->mergeCasts(['options' => 'array']); } }
```

#### Apply explicit tenant predicates to lower-level queries
- **Do:** Apply explicit tenant predicates to lower-level queries.
- **Flag when:** Flag when DB::table or analytical queries read tenant-owned data without tenant filtering.
- **Why:** Eloquent global scopes do not apply to raw/query-builder operations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
DB::table('invoices')->get();
```

After:
```php
DB::table('invoices')->where('tenant_id', $tenant->id)->get();
```

#### Scope nested loading styles to the triggering element
- **Do:** Scope nested loading styles to the triggering element.
- **Flag when:** Flag when in-data-loading variants react to unrelated loading ancestors.
- **Why:** Element-scoped variants avoid cross-region loading feedback.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class="in-data-loading:opacity-50"
```

After:
```php
class="data-loading:opacity-50"
```

#### Invalidate dependent caches on every authoritative change path
- **Do:** Invalidate dependent caches on every authoritative change path.
- **Flag when:** Flag when model-derived caches survive saves/deletes or bulk writes without an explicit invalidation strategy.
- **Why:** Central lifecycle invalidation covers model writes; bulk operations require their own invalidation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Controllers clear the cache inconsistently.
```

After:
```php
// Register saved/deleted invalidation and explicit bulk-write invalidation.
```

#### Use Str::slug() for one-off unpersisted slugs
- **Do:** Use Str::slug() for one-off unpersisted slugs.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a model slug-generation package is introduced solely for ephemeral string formatting.
- **Why:** A simple helper avoids unnecessary model lifecycle integration.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Create a throwaway model to generate a URL-safe string.
```

After:
```php
$slug = Str::slug($title);
```

#### Restore temporarily changed application/model state in finally
- **Do:** Restore temporarily changed application/model state in finally.
- **Flag when:** Flag when temporary locale or other mutable context is restored only after a successful callback.
- **Why:** Finally restores state even on exceptions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$previous = app()->getLocale(); app()->setLocale($locale); render(); app()->setLocale($previous);
```

After:
```php
try { app()->setLocale($locale); render(); } finally { app()->setLocale($previous); }
```

#### Detect inherited and nested model traits recursively
- **Do:** Detect inherited and nested model traits recursively.
- **Flag when:** Flag when tooling checks only direct class_uses and misses parent/nested traits.
- **Why:** Model behavior often comes from inherited trait composition.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$traits = class_uses($model);
```

After:
```php
$traits = class_uses_recursive($model);
```

#### Annotate custom builders and their model registration with matching generic types
- **Do:** Annotate custom builders and their model registration with matching generic types.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom builder loses its model type or HasBuilder names the wrong builder.
- **Why:** Matching generics preserve inference through custom query APIs.
- **Enforced by:** partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Generics\ClassAncestorsRule, partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Methods\MissingMethodReturnTypehintRule

Before:
```php
class UserBuilder extends Builder {}
```

After:
```php
/** @extends Builder<User> */ class UserBuilder extends Builder {}
// Model: @use HasBuilder<UserBuilder>
```

#### Use generic templates to preserve linked argument and return types in reusable APIs
- **Do:** Use separate PHPDoc template, parameter and return tags to preserve linked model types in reusable APIs.
- **Flag when:** Flag APIs that erase the relationship between input and return model types or place multiple PHPDoc tags on one line so later tags are not parsed.
- **Why:** Templates let analysis preserve the caller concrete model type.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
/** @return Model */ function identity(Model $model) { return $model; }
```

After:
```php
/**
 * @template T of Model
 * @param T $model
 * @return T
 */
function identity(Model $model)
{
    return $model;
}
```

#### Return normalized storage values from Attribute mutator callbacks
- **Do:** Have an Attribute::make(set: ...) callback return the normalized scalar or multi-column attribute array for Eloquent to merge, instead of mutating $this->attributes and implicitly returning null.
- **Flag when:** Flag Attribute setter callbacks that directly write the raw attribute array without returning the intended storage representation.
- **Why:** The Attribute setter pipeline merges the callback return value; an implicit null can overwrite the assigned attribute and bypass the expected conversion contract.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
set: function ($value) { $this->attributes['name'] = trim($value); }
```

After:
```php
set: fn (string $value) => trim($value)
```

#### Move substantial page-data preparation into a focused view model
- **Do:** When page-data preparation becomes substantial or repeatedly assembles the same presentation contract, extract a focused view-model/data class, optionally composed of nested laravel-data objects, and have the controller pass its explicit payload to the view or Inertia page.
- **Flag when:** Flag controllers that mix substantial repeated presentation assembly with request orchestration, or page contracts scattered across unrelated ad-hoc arrays.
- **Why:** A focused view model gives presentation data one owner and keeps the HTTP adapter small while making nested payload contracts explicit.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Controller repeatedly builds a large nested page payload alongside HTTP handling.
```

After:
```php
return Inertia::render('Orders/Show', OrderPageData::from($order));
```

#### Use Livewire model-typed action parameters for ordinary record lookup
- **Do:** When a Livewire action needs a model by its submitted ID and ordinary model binding has the right lookup/missing behavior, accept the model as a typed action parameter and authorize the resolved record before acting on it.
- **Flag when:** Flag repeated manual primary-key lookup boilerplate in a Livewire action where supported model parameter binding supplies the same semantics; never treat successful binding as authorization.
- **Why:** Typed model binding removes duplicate lookup code while keeping the client-controlled identifier and authorization boundary visible.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function delete(int $id): void { $todo = Todo::findOrFail($id); $this->authorize("delete", $todo); $todo->delete(); }
```

After:
```php
public function delete(Todo $todo): void { $this->authorize("delete", $todo); $todo->delete(); }
```

#### Keep an adopted repository contract independent of Eloquent builders
- **Do:** When a repository is an intentional module/domain boundary, return the promised domain result or collection and expose explicit operations instead of leaking a builder for callers to modify. Shape repositories around use cases rather than automatically creating one per model.
- **Flag when:** Flag a repository abstraction whose callers must add Eloquent constraints or understand internal model persistence to use it.
- **Why:** A leaking builder defeats the boundary the repository was introduced to provide.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$repository->query()->where("customer_id", $id)->get();
```

After:
```php
$orders = $repository->outstandingForCustomer($customerId);
```

#### Match implicitly bound model parameter names to route placeholders
- **Do:** For implicit route model binding, name the type-hinted model parameter to match its route placeholder. Use an explicit binding when the parameter contract intentionally differs.
- **Flag when:** Flag a route placeholder and controller model parameter with different names where implicit binding is expected.
- **Why:** Laravel needs the matching parameter name to substitute the route value with the model.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::get('/users/{user}', fn (User $account) => $account);
```

After:
```php
Route::get('/users/{user}', fn (User $user) => new UserResource($user));
```

#### Create custom resource collection classes only for collection behavior
- **Do:** Use the item resource collection helper for ordinary lists. Add a dedicated ResourceCollection only when the collection needs its own transformation, links, metadata or other behavior.
- **Flag when:** Flag one empty custom resource collection per model with no collection-level behavior.
- **Why:** An ad hoc resource collection already applies the item transformation without extra boilerplate.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class UserCollection extends ResourceCollection {} // adds no behavior
```

After:
```php
return UserResource::collection($users);
```

#### Stream or chunk very large outbound uploads
- **Do:** For outbound payloads too large to buffer safely, use the upstream supported streaming, multipart-file or chunked transfer contract instead of constructing one huge in-memory Http::post body.
- **Flag when:** Flag a very large outbound body materialized in PHP memory despite a supported bounded upload mechanism.
- **Why:** Bounded transfer reduces peak memory and request-size failures.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Http::post($url, ['file' => file_get_contents($path)]);
```

After:
```php
$handle = fopen($path, 'rb');
try { Http::attach('file', $handle, basename($path))->post($url); } finally { fclose($handle); }
```

#### Do not expect atomic counter methods to persist unrelated dirty fields
- **Do:** Save or otherwise persist unrelated model changes explicitly when increment()/decrement() is also used. Do not treat the counter operation as save() for all dirty attributes.
- **Flag when:** Flag an unsaved attribute assignment followed only by increment()/decrement() when both changes are expected to persist.
- **Why:** Atomic counter updates do not write every dirty model attribute.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$user->name = $name;
$user->increment('login_count'); // expects name persisted too
```

After:
```php
$user->name = $name;
$user->save();
$user->increment('login_count'); // wrap required atomic workflow in a transaction
```

#### Do not use model refresh as a fresh authorization-scoped lookup
- **Do:** Treat fresh()/refresh() as reloading the already identified record without ordinary global scopes. When current visibility or tenant authorization must be rechecked, issue an explicitly constrained authorized query instead.
- **Flag when:** Flag refresh() being relied upon to reject a record newly outside a tenant or visibility scope.
- **Why:** Refreshing by model identity is not an authorization or global-scope admission check.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$record->refresh(); // assumed to reapply tenant visibility
```

After:
```php
$record = $authorizedRecords->whereKey($record->getKey())->firstOrFail();
```

#### Validate large imports in bounded batches
- **Do:** Validate large imported datasets in bounded batches or rows instead of handing the entire file to one Validator instance. Keep file-wide uniqueness and cross-row invariants explicit when splitting validation.
- **Flag when:** Flag an unbounded import array expanded into one large nested validator rule set.
- **Why:** Rule expansion and accumulated validation state can exhaust memory before persistence begins.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Validator::make(['rows' => $allRows], ['rows.*.email' => ['required', 'email']])->validate();
```

After:
```php
foreach ($reader->chunks(500) as $rows) { validateImportBatch($rows); persistValidatedBatch($rows); }
```

#### Use Boot and Initialize attributes for deliberately attributed model hooks
- **Do:** When adopting Laravel 13 attributed model hooks, mark one-time static registration methods with #[Boot] and per-instance initializers with #[Initialize]. Preserve the distinction between class booting and instance initialization.
- **Flag when:** Flag attributed boot logic on a nonstatic method, instance state initialized only once, or inconsistent hook style under the adopted attribute convention.
- **Why:** The attributes permit descriptive hook names while preserving Eloquent lifecycle phases.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
trait HasCode { public static function bootHasCode(): void { /* registration */ } }
```

After:
```php
trait HasCode { #[\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Boot] public static function registerCodeHooks(): void { /* registration */ } }
```

#### Represent pending and final states of long-running remote actions
- **Do:** For an asynchronous remote action, expose an in-progress state as work is accepted, then reconcile success or failure from the real result and publish that state to interested clients.
- **Flag when:** Flag a long-running remote toggle shown as complete before the remote result, or left pending after failure.
- **Why:** Explicit operation state gives immediate feedback without confusing accepted work with completed work.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$server->maintenance_enabled = true; // remote action has not completed
```

After:
```php
markOperationPending($operation);
// Worker result: markSucceeded() or markFailed(); broadcast the final state.
```

#### Select a scalar from a large related collection with a correlated subquery
- **Do:** Select a scalar from a large related collection with a correlated subquery.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code loads a complete has-many relation only to use one scalar per parent.
- **Why:** A scalar subquery avoids hydrating unrelated rows and keeps work in the database.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$users = User::with('logins')->get(); // only latest created_at needed
```

After:
```php
$users = User::addSelect(['last_login_at' => Login::select('created_at')->whereColumn('user_id', 'users.id')->latest()->limit(1)])->get();
```

#### Select a related key with a subquery and eager-load its belongsTo relation when only one child model is needed
- **Do:** Select a related key with a subquery and eager-load its belongsTo relation when only one child model is needed.
- **Flag when:** Flag when all children are eager-loaded solely to choose one related model per parent.
- **Why:** Selecting one key bounds hydration while preserving normal relationship behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$users = User::with('logins')->get();
```

After:
```php
$users = User::addSelect(['last_login_id' => Login::select('id')->whereColumn('user_id', 'users.id')->latest()->limit(1)])->with('lastLogin')->get();
```

#### Allow lazy loading only when a relationship is genuinely optional or a bounded single-model read
- **Do:** Allow lazy loading only when a relationship is genuinely optional or a bounded single-model read.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a global loading policy fetches expensive relations even when a single-model branch rarely uses them.
- **Why:** Conditional lazy loading can avoid unused work when it does not introduce a collection-level N+1 pattern.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$user = User::with('auditEntries')->findOrFail($id);
```

After:
```php
$user = User::findOrFail($id); if ($showAudit) { $entries = $user->auditEntries; }
```

#### Resolve model-configured table names when lower-level application queries must follow the model
- **Do:** Resolve model-configured table names when lower-level application queries must follow the model.
- **Flag when:** Flag when application query code hard-codes a table name that can differ from its model configuration.
- **Why:** getTable keeps lower-level query code aligned with model table configuration.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
DB::table('users')->count();
```

After:
```php
DB::table((new User)->getTable())->count();
```
