- **Flag when:** Flag when substantial prompt structure or repeated persona/instruction fragments are copied into heredocs or concatenated across callers.
- **Why:** Templates separate prompt structure from application control flow and centralize shared wording.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Review consequential AI output before acting on it
- **Do:** Require an appropriately qualified human to review AI-generated analysis or recommendations before they drive consequential actions, checking the supporting evidence and correcting unsupported conclusions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when consequential decisions use model analysis as accepted fact without the required human review.
- **Why:** Plausible model output can omit context or invent conclusions that affect real decisions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Choose a measured Vue Vapor adoption boundary
- **Do:** Where the installed Vue/compiler release supports Vapor and the project accepts its release status, evaluate it first on a performance-sensitive component or page. Use createVaporApp for an entirely compatible Vapor tree; when mixing VDOM and Vapor, install the required interop support, account for both runtimes and verify adapter/plugin compatibility.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Vapor conversion assumes a smaller bundle despite mixed runtimes, or rewrites the whole frontend before checking performance and integration compatibility.
- **Why:** Selective adoption limits migration scope, while an all-Vapor entry is what permits removing the VDOM runtime.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Report expected Livewire login rejection as a form error
- **Do:** Report invalid credentials through Livewire's field-error flow, such as addError or a supported validation failure, and return without throwing an unexpected application exception.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an ordinary rejected login becomes a generic server exception instead of an actionable credentials error on the form.
- **Why:** Expected authentication rejection should keep the form usable and avoid treating normal invalid input as an application failure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid credentials');
```

After:
```php
$this->addError('email', __('auth.failed'));
return;
```

#### Introduce a new frontend paradigm at page boundaries
- **Do:** When a new frontend paradigm can coexist with the current stack, adopt it on a bounded page or route first and verify shared navigation, assets and authentication before expanding.
- **Flag when:** Flag when adopting a compatible new rendering approach triggers an unnecessary whole-frontend rewrite before one page proves the integration.
- **Why:** Page boundaries allow gradual validation while limiting migration scope.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Version repository-backed flat-file CMS content
- **Do:** For a CMS using a repository-backed flat-file content workflow, track the intended content files in Git and route content edits through the project's review and deployment process.
- **Flag when:** Flag when repository-backed content changes bypass version history or cannot be restored and reviewed with their associated release.
- **Why:** Content history and reviewed deployments make flat-file site changes traceable and recoverable.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Route full-page Livewire components through their lifecycle
- **Do:** Register a full-page class-based Livewire component as the route action itself, or use the installed Livewire page-route API for view-based components; do not route directly to its render method.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a route uses [Component::class, "render"] and bypasses Livewire mounting and hydration setup.
- **Why:** Rendering the template alone can produce initial HTML whose Livewire interactions do not work.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::get('/quotes', [QuotePage::class, 'render']);
```

After:
```php
Route::get('/quotes', QuotePage::class);
```

#### Distinguish full-page components under the Page suffix convention
- **Do:** When adopting the class-based Livewire Page suffix convention, name route-level components with a Page suffix and keep embedded components under their ordinary component names.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a route-level component breaks the selected Page suffix convention and its role is ambiguous in the component tree.
- **Why:** A consistent naming policy makes full-page and embedded components easy to distinguish.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Review standalone technical documentation for continued accuracy
- **Do:** Assign a recurring review cadence to important standalone references, SDK guides, tutorials and runbooks, checking their commands, assumptions and safety against the current supported system.
- **Flag when:** Flag when important operational or integration documentation has no accountable accuracy review and retains known obsolete or unsafe instructions.
- **Why:** Documentation can become wrong even when it is not touched by a specific code change.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Target mobile JavaScript updates to compatible native runtimes
- **Do:** For an Expo/React Native companion app, deliver eligible JavaScript-only fixes through EAS Update only to builds with a matching native runtime. Rebuild and use the store release path when the fix changes native code or native configuration.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an over-the-air bundle expects native modules or configuration absent from its targeted installed builds.
- **Why:** JavaScript updates cannot supply a missing or incompatible native layer.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Plan for variable mobile store-review time
- **Do:** Include store submission, variable review time and possible rejection/resubmission in mobile release schedules instead of promising availability immediately after uploading a build.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a committed mobile release date assumes the first store submission is approved immediately or treats a typical review duration as a guaranteed maximum.
- **Why:** Review delays and requested corrections can move the actual public release date.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Make permission pre-prompts describe the next system action
- **Do:** When showing a custom screen before an iOS protected-resource permission alert, explain the purpose and use neutral action text such as Continue or Next to open the actual system prompt; follow current platform guidance for the requested resource.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom pre-prompt implies its button already grants system permission or pressures the user to consent.
- **Why:** Permission is granted through the system dialog, and the custom screen must accurately describe that next step.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Check the DOM cost of repeated component wrappers
- **Do:** When composing large pages from nested or repeated components, inspect their rendered DOM and remove unnecessary wrapper elements where they materially increase node count or nesting.
- **Flag when:** Flag when repeated components create large wrapper-only DOM trees that contribute measured layout, rendering or interaction cost.
- **Why:** A small wrapper in each component can multiply into a costly page-wide tree.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Keep small single-use prototype components near their owner
- **Do:** During prototyping, keep a small single-use helper component beside its parent when that improves local comprehension; move it to a dedicated module when reuse or complexity creates a real boundary.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an unproven tiny helper requires unnecessary cross-file indirection or a genuinely reused helper remains copied inside several parents.
- **Why:** Locality speeds early iteration while later extraction can follow an established contract.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Keep React data flow directed through props and callbacks
- **Do:** Pass values down to React children through props and communicate child changes through callbacks or events owned by the parent instead of mutating parent props or reaching into parent internals.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a child changes parent-owned data outside the declared callback/state contract.
- **Why:** One-way data flow keeps state ownership and updates predictable.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Use standalone Filament builders without imposing a whole panel
- **Do:** When an ordinary application page needs Filament form or table capabilities but not a complete panel, integrate the supported standalone builder Livewire components and their required contracts/assets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a full admin panel is introduced solely to obtain a form/table that the installed standalone builder supports.
- **Why:** Standalone builders supply the needed interaction without forcing unrelated panel navigation and structure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Separate Filament panels for distinct audiences
- **Do:** Use separately configured Filament panels when admin and client audiences require materially different navigation, resources, appearance or access boundaries, and authorize each panel explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when one panel accumulates pervasive audience branches for interfaces with distinct navigation and configuration needs.
- **Why:** Separate panel configuration keeps audience-specific behavior understandable and independently controlled.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Enable Filament self-registration only by deliberate policy
- **Do:** Keep public Filament registration disabled unless that panel is intended for self-sign-up. Provision administrative users through the authorized management/CLI path rather than opening registration for setup convenience.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an administrative panel enables registration solely to create its initial users without an intended public enrollment policy.
- **Why:** User provisioning and public self-registration are different access decisions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Keep preview builds within the feedback cycle
- **Do:** Measure and reduce preview/staging build and deployment delays so reviewers can verify ordinary changes promptly; set a team-appropriate feedback budget and investigate builds that repeatedly exceed it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when routine preview verification is delayed enough to interrupt the agreed development feedback cycle and no bottleneck investigation is in progress.
- **Why:** Long preview delays discourage frequent verification and slow small changes.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Make pending code reviews visible and routinely owned
- **Do:** Reserve regular team time for code review, distribute review responsibility and use appropriately scoped reminders for pending reviews when needed.
- **Flag when:** Flag when review queues repeatedly stall because reviews have no routine ownership or visibility.
- **Why:** A shared cadence and visible pending work reduce reliance on ad hoc interruption or one reviewer.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Use recurring support evidence to improve confusing features
- **Do:** Review support tickets and documentation usage regularly to identify repeated confusion and turn confirmed patterns into interface or documentation improvements.
- **Flag when:** Flag when recurring user confusion remains visible in support evidence but only escalated defects inform product fixes.
- **Why:** Repeated support questions reveal usability problems that may never be reported as bugs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Use the official tool for supported Tailwind major migrations
- **Do:** For a supported Tailwind 3-to-4 migration, run the official upgrade tool on a recoverable branch, review its changes and complete the manual steps and visual verification from the upgrade guide.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a supported migration hand-rewrites all mechanical syntax without evaluating the official migration path, or accepts automated output without review.
- **Why:** The upgrade tool handles mechanical changes while review catches application-specific styling differences.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Keep interacting list features under one Livewire state owner
- **Do:** When list interactions such as search and bookmarking share the same query and state, keep that state in a cohesive page/list Livewire component and use presentational children unless independent child lifecycles are needed.
- **Flag when:** Flag when each card owns a separate Livewire lifecycle solely to manipulate state that all cards and the page must coordinate.
- **Why:** A shared state owner avoids unnecessary prop/event synchronization and fragmented list updates.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Preserve stored files when edit forms contain no replacement upload
- **Do:** Keep file inputs empty on edit forms, show the currently stored image separately and replace it only when a validated new upload is submitted.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an unchanged edit submits a stored image URL as if it were an upload or clears/replaces the file because the file input is empty.
- **Why:** A file input represents a new local selection, not an existing server file.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Derive visible sections from existing Livewire state
- **Do:** When section visibility is fully determined by existing form/result state, express that condition directly in Blade rather than maintaining a second public show flag that must be synchronized.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a redundant show boolean can disagree with the actual results or workflow state after updates or resets.
- **Why:** Derived visibility avoids an extra mutable value and synchronization paths.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Fail early on missing Inertia page components
- **Do:** Enable inertia.pages.ensure_pages_exist where missing or misnamed Inertia components must fail during server rendering.
- **Flag when:** Flag when page-name errors are allowed through the server and discovered only by failed client resolution.
- **Why:** Existence checking makes missing pages easier to catch in tests and deployment verification.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
'pages' => ['ensure_pages_exist' => false]
```

After:
```php
'pages' => ['ensure_pages_exist' => true]
```

#### Health-check the Inertia SSR service
- **Do:** Run inertia:check-ssr from deployment checks or monitoring and act on a nonzero exit.
- **Flag when:** Flag when SSR deployments have no check that the rendering service is reachable.
- **Why:** A process can fail independently of the PHP web application.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Install pcntl for managed Inertia SSR shutdown
- **Do:** Install the pcntl PHP extension on hosts running inertia:start-ssr when signal-based clean shutdown is required.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the managed SSR launcher lacks pcntl and cannot handle its documented termination signals cleanly.
- **Why:** Signal handling lets supervisors stop and restart the renderer predictably.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Do not assign untrusted input to locked properties
- **Do:** Validate and authorize any server-side assignment to a locked property.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an action copies an untrusted argument into a #[Locked] identifier without checking access.
- **Why:** Locked only prevents client hydration changes; component methods can still assign unsafe values.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function select($id) { $this->postId = $id; }
```

After:
```php
public function select(Post $post) { $this->authorize('view', $post); $this->postId = $post->id; }
```

#### Make internal Livewire helpers nonpublic
- **Do:** Declare helper and dangerous internal methods protected or private, exposing only intended browser actions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a helper method is public even though it must not be callable as a Livewire action.
- **Why:** Every public action surface must be safe for direct browser invocation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function deleteAllRecords(): void { /* internal */ }
```

After:
```php
protected function deleteAllRecords(): void { /* internal */ }
```

#### Key child component instances by identity
- **Do:** Give every looped or dynamically selected child Livewire component its own key derived from its entity and component identity.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a child component lacks its own key, relies only on an enclosing keyed element, or retains a key when switching component types.
- **Why:** Child instances have their own lifecycle and need identity separate from their surrounding DOM.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<livewire:post-row :post="$post" />
```

After:
```php
<livewire:post-row :post="$post" :key="'post-row-'.$post->id" />
```

#### Show unsaved state in auto-saving forms
- **Do:** Show dirty feedback for Livewire fields that save asynchronously.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an auto-saving interface gives no indication that changed values have not yet persisted.
- **Why:** Dirty feedback distinguishes a local edit from a completed save.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<input wire:model.live="title">
```

After:
```php
<input wire:model.live="title"><span wire:dirty wire:target="title">Unsaved</span>
```

#### Reset mount-initialized state explicitly
- **Do:** Restore mount-initialized values explicitly instead of expecting reset to rerun mount.
- **Flag when:** Flag when reset is used to recover a value assigned in mount but the required initial value differs from the declared property default.
- **Why:** Reset restores pre-mount defaults and does not repeat initialization.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function cancel() { $this->reset('title'); }
```

After:
```php
public function cancel() { $this->title = $this->post->title; }
```

#### Reset form fields through Livewire defaults
- **Do:** Use reset or pull to clear submitted Livewire fields when their declared defaults are the intended next state.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an action repeats hard-coded default values for fields that already declare those same defaults.
- **Why:** Framework resets keep the field defaults in one place.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$this->title = ''; // duplicated default
```

After:
```php
$this->reset('title');
```

#### Give resettable typed form properties defaults
- **Do:** Initialize typed Livewire Form properties that will be reset.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a resettable typed form field has no default and becomes uninitialized after reset.
- **Why:** Reset must leave a valid initialized state for subsequent rendering.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public string $title;
```

After:
```php
public string $title = '';
```

#### Keep computed values on the Livewire component
- **Do:** Define #[Computed] methods on the component rather than Livewire Form objects.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Form class declares a computed property and expects Livewire component computed behavior.
- **Why:** Form objects do not support the same computed-property interface.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class PostForm extends Form { #[Computed] public function total() {} }
```

After:
```php
class Editor extends Component { #[Computed] public function total() {} }
```

#### Give shared computed caches explicit keys
- **Do:** Use an explicit invalidatable key for app-wide cached Livewire computed values and clear it when its source changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a shared computed cache has no reliable invalidation key or is reused for user-specific data without scoping.
- **Why:** Explicit keys make cache ownership and invalidation reviewable.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
#[Computed(cache: true)]
```

After:
```php
#[Computed(cache: true, key: 'public-categories')]
```

#### Target named paginators explicitly
- **Do:** Pass pageName when navigating or resetting named Livewire paginators and use their matching update hooks.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a component with named or multiple paginators resets or moves the default page instead of the intended paginator.
- **Why:** Explicit names prevent one results list from changing another list page.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$this->resetPage();
```

After:
```php
$this->resetPage(pageName: 'invoicesPage');
```

#### Key dependent selects by their parent value
- **Do:** Give a dependent Livewire select a wire:key derived from the selection that determines its options.
- **Flag when:** Flag when changing a parent select leaves stale child selection or DOM state despite a new options list.
- **Why:** Changing the key lets Livewire rebuild the dependent control with the correct state.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<select wire:model="city">...</select>
```

After:
```php
<select wire:model="city" wire:key="cities-{{ $state }}">...</select>
```

#### Model URL empty values and defaults explicitly
- **Do:** Use nullable Url properties when empty means null and specify except when a mount-assigned default must not determine omission.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an empty parameter is interpreted as the wrong value or a nonempty mount default disappears from shared URLs.
- **Why:** Explicit types and omission values preserve URL semantics.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
#[Url] public string $search = '';
```

After:
```php
#[Url(except: '')] public ?string $search = null;
```

#### Use component data inside islands
- **Do:** Source island data from component properties or computed values instead of outer loop or @php locals.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an independently rendered island references a local variable defined outside its boundary.
- **Why:** Independent island rendering cannot rely on the surrounding template execution scope.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
@php $rows = slowQuery(); @endphp
@island {{ $rows }} @endisland
```

After:
```php
@island {{ $this->rows }} @endisland
```

#### Place control structures inside islands
- **Do:** Put loops and conditionals inside the island rather than wrapping the island in template control structures.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an @island declaration is nested inside @foreach, @if, or another unsupported control structure.
- **Why:** An island needs a stable independently addressable rendering boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
@if($show) @island ... @endisland @endif
```

After:
```php
@island @if($show) ... @endif @endisland
```

#### Guarantee recursive component termination
- **Do:** Guard recursive component rendering with a terminating condition and reject cyclic relationships.
- **Flag when:** Flag when recursive component rendering can follow a cycle or has no bounded stopping condition.
- **Why:** Unbounded recursion can exhaust rendering time or memory.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<livewire:tree-node :node="$node->parent" />
```

After:
```php
@if($node->parent && !$visited->contains($node->parent_id)) ... @endif
```

#### Place persist blocks outside components
- **Do:** Place @persist regions in the shared layout outside Livewire component boundaries.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an @persist block is declared inside a Livewire component template.
- **Why:** Persistent DOM needs a stable owner across component navigation and replacement.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<!-- livewire component --> @persist('player') ... @endpersist
```

After:
```php
{{-- main layout, outside Livewire component markup --}}
@persist('player')<audio controls src="{{ $trackUrl }}"></audio>@endpersist
```

#### Set temporary upload validation deliberately
- **Do:** Configure Livewire temporary upload rules to the accepted file types and sizes in the application.
- **Flag when:** Flag when temporary upload validation accepts arbitrary files or sizes inconsistent with the final form requirements.
- **Why:** Temporary storage is exposed before the final submit validation runs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
'temporary_file_upload' => ['rules' => null]
```

After:
```php
'temporary_file_upload' => ['rules' => 'file|mimes:jpg,png|max:5120']
```

#### Keep temporary upload cleanup enabled
- **Do:** Keep Livewire temporary-file cleanup enabled and configure the S3 lifecycle cleanup when temporary uploads use S3.
- **Flag when:** Flag when temporary cleanup is disabled or S3 livewire-tmp objects have no expiry rule.
- **Why:** Abandoned uploads otherwise accumulate storage indefinitely.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Save only after upload completion
- **Do:** Trigger save from the success callback of $wire.upload rather than awaiting its non-Promise return.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code awaits $wire.upload and immediately saves before the transfer completion callback.
- **Why:** The upload API does not provide the Promise sequencing that await would require.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
await $wire.upload('photo', file); $wire.save();
```

After:
```php
$wire.upload('photo', file, () => $wire.save());
```

#### Protect third-party upload widgets from morphing and duplicate submits
- **Do:** Wrap third-party upload editor DOM in wire:ignore and disable confirmation during an active upload.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Livewire morphs editor-owned DOM or users can confirm repeatedly while its upload is running.
- **Why:** The editor needs DOM ownership and a single transfer lifecycle.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<div id="editor"></div><button>Confirm</button>
```

After:
```php
<div wire:ignore id="editor"></div><button :disabled="uploading">Confirm</button>
```

#### Keep Livewire payload limits enabled
- **Do:** Retain finite Livewire payload size, nesting, call-count, and component-count limits appropriate to the application.
- **Flag when:** Flag when payload guards are set to null or disabled without a bounded replacement.
- **Why:** Bounded payloads limit denial-of-service work before actions run.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
'payload' => ['max_size' => null]
```

After:
```php
'payload' => ['max_size' => 1048576] // choose an application-appropriate bound
```

#### Clean up Livewire JavaScript registrations
- **Do:** Prefer component-scoped interceptors and remove global listeners, directives listeners, and hooks when their owner is removed.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a component registers global callbacks or DOM listeners without an unsubscribe or cleanup path.
- **Why:** Unremoved callbacks accumulate across navigation and fire more than once.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Livewire.on('saved', callback);
```

After:
```php
const cleanup = Livewire.on('saved', callback); // invoke in owner cleanup
```

#### Namespace reusable trait lifecycle hooks
- **Do:** Suffix reusable Livewire trait lifecycle hooks with the trait name to avoid collisions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when two reusable traits declare the same unsuffixed mount or updated hook.
- **Why:** Trait-specific hooks let Livewire invoke each behavior without method conflicts.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
trait HasPostForm { public function mount() {} }
```

After:
```php
trait HasPostForm { public function mountHasPostForm() {} }
```

#### Declare array-shaped synthesizers accurately
- **Do:** Implement ArrayShapedSynth only when the synthesizer hydrate method requires an array.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a scalar synthesizer implements ArrayShapedSynth or an array-dependent one omits its required contract.
- **Why:** The contract controls payload expectations and must match the hydrated shape.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class DateSynth extends Synth implements ArrayShapedSynth {}
```

After:
```php
class DateSynth extends Synth {}
```

#### Refresh Livewire browser assets after package changes
- **Do:** Rebuild manually bundled Livewire JavaScript after Composer updates and republish published Livewire assets automatically when the package changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Composer updates Livewire while deployed browser assets remain from the previous package version.
- **Why:** Mismatched PHP and JavaScript versions can break hydration and requests.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Avoid emoji filenames in Composer-shipped components
- **Do:** Use component filenames without the lightning emoji when shipping Livewire components in Composer packages.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Composer package publishes Livewire component filenames with the emoji prefix.
- **Why:** Some packaging and publishing workflows mishandle those filenames.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
resources/views/components/⚡alert.blade.php
```

After:
```php
resources/views/components/alert.blade.php
```

#### Keep generated single-file component names unambiguous
- **Do:** Use distinct names or component namespaces for single-file Livewire components that would generate conflicting class names.
- **Flag when:** Flag when same-named SFCs in different unnamespaced directories generate colliding component classes.
- **Why:** Explicit identity prevents resolving or generating the wrong class.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
components/admin/card.blade.php and components/shop/card.blade.php
```

After:
```php
// Register separate admin::card and shop::card namespaces.
```

#### Prevent anchor navigation for Livewire click actions
- **Do:** Use wire:click.prevent or a button when an anchor triggers a Livewire action instead of navigation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an action anchor follows its href in addition to sending the Livewire action.
- **Why:** Preventing default avoids competing navigation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<a href="#" wire:click="show">Show</a>
```

After:
```php
<a href="#" wire:click.prevent="show">Show</a>
```

#### Record viewport impressions only once
- **Do:** Use the once modifier for intersection-triggered analytics that should count one view per component appearance.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a wire:intersect analytics action records repeatedly as the same element re-enters the viewport.
- **Why:** A one-time trigger prevents inflated impression counts.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<div wire:intersect="recordView">
```

After:
```php
<div wire:intersect.once="recordView">
```

#### Bind local-state-dependent attributes on the client
- **Do:** Use wire:bind or the supported client binding when an attribute must reflect client state before a server render.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Blade-only attribute condition remains stale while its underlying client state changes.
- **Why:** Client binding keeps attributes synchronized without an extra round trip.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<button @disabled($selected === null)>Continue</button>
```

After:
```php
<button wire:bind:disabled="selected === null">Continue</button>
```

#### Skip transitions for immediate reset and cancel actions
- **Do:** Skip Livewire view transitions on reset or cancel actions when the change should apply immediately.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a reset or cancel unnecessarily animates through a view transition and delays the expected immediate state.
- **Why:** Immediate cancellation avoids distracting transition work.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function cancel() { /* reset */ }
```

After:
```php
#[Transition(skip: true)]
public function cancel() { /* reset */ }
```

#### Evaluate closure-capable Filament options in getters
- **Do:** Evaluate closure-capable Filament options in getters.
- **Flag when:** Flag when custom configuration resolves closures directly or fails to accept closures where utilities must be injected.
- **Why:** Evaluation supplies Filament utilities and supports both static and dynamic configuration.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected string $zoom;
```

After:
```php
protected string|Closure|null $zoom = null;
public function getZoom() { return $this->evaluate($this->zoom); }
```

#### Customize Filament appearance through semantic CSS hooks
- **Do:** Customize Filament appearance through semantic CSS hooks.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a styling-only customization copies internal Blade views or adds unscanned utilities to package markup instead of stable CSS hooks.
- **Why:** Semantic hook classes reduce copied markup and upgrade drift.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<!-- copy vendor button HTML to change rounding -->
```

After:
```php
.fi-btn { @apply rounded-sm; }
```

#### Register Filament panel providers
- **Do:** Register Filament panel providers.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a panel provider exists but is absent from bootstrap/providers.php.
- **Why:** Laravel must load the provider to register the panel.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return [App\Providers\AppServiceProvider::class];
```

After:
```php
return [App\Providers\AppServiceProvider::class, App\Providers\Filament\AdminPanelProvider::class];
```

#### Restrict destructive Filament scaffolding to new projects
- **Do:** Use filament:install --scaffold only in a new project and integrate components manually into existing applications.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an existing application setup script runs the overwriting scaffold command.
- **Why:** The scaffolder can replace application-owned files.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Include Filament styles and scripts in custom layouts
- **Do:** Include Filament styles and scripts in custom layouts.
- **Flag when:** Flag when standalone Filament components lack their required CSS/Vite integration or runtime script directives.
- **Why:** The components need matching styles and JavaScript outside panel layouts too.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<head>@vite('resources/js/app.js')</head>
```

After:
```php
<head>@filamentStyles @vite('resources/js/app.js')</head><body>...@filamentScripts</body>
```

#### Use clusters for deeper Filament navigation
- **Do:** Use clusters for deeper Filament navigation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when navigation attempts a third parent-item level instead of the supported cluster structure.
- **Why:** Clusters model grouped resources without unsupported nesting.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected static ?string $navigationParentItem = 'Third level';
```

After:
```php
protected static ?string $cluster = CustomerManagement::class;
```

#### Defer expensive Filament tab badge queries
- **Do:** Defer expensive Filament tab badge queries using a closure and deferBadge(), and give the enclosing Tabs component a stable key.
- **Flag when:** Flag eager badge queries or deferred badges whose enclosing Tabs component lacks a stable key.
- **Why:** Deferred closures let the page render before expensive counts finish.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Tabs::make('Reports')->tabs([Tab::make('Orders')->badge(Order::count())])
```

After:
```php
Tabs::make('Reports')->key('report-tabs')->tabs([
    Tab::make('Orders')->badge(fn () => Order::count())->deferBadge(),
])
```

#### Let Filament invoke trait lifecycle hooks
- **Do:** Let Filament invoke trait lifecycle hooks.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a page or importer manually invokes trait hooks that Filament also invokes automatically.
- **Why:** Manual invocation duplicates side effects and processing.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected function beforeSave() { $this->beforeSaveAudit(); }
```

After:
```php
protected function beforeSave() { /* page-specific behavior only */ }
```

#### Halt rejected Filament saves and explain why
- **Do:** Halt rejected Filament saves and explain why.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a lifecycle guard returns normally or throws an unhelpful failure while allowing save processing to continue.
- **Why:** An explicit halt stops the operation and a notification explains the unmet condition.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
if (!$allowed) { return; }
```

After:
```php
if (!$allowed) { Notification::make()->danger()->title('Cannot save')->send(); $this->halt(); }
```

#### Use View pages for read-only record access
- **Do:** Use View pages for read-only record access.
- **Flag when:** Flag when view-only users are directed to an Edit page with read-only fields and therefore require update permission.
- **Why:** A View page has the correct authorization and interaction contract for read-only access.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Read-only tabs on EditCustomer
```

After:
```php
public static function getPages(): array { return ['view' => ViewCustomer::route('/{record}')]; }
```

#### Extract heavily configured reusable Filament controls
- **Do:** Extract heavily configured reusable Filament controls.
- **Flag when:** Flag when resource configuration repeats large field or action definitions across multiple pages.
- **Why:** Dedicated control classes keep resource configuration focused and share stable behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make('customer')->required() /* repeated long setup */
```

After:
```php
CustomerNameInput::make()
```

#### Centralize Filament navigation group metadata in an enum
- **Do:** Centralize Filament navigation group metadata in an enum.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the same navigation group labels, icons, and order are repeated as inconsistent strings.
- **Why:** An enum keeps related group metadata in one typed definition.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->navigationGroup('Customers')
```

After:
```php
->navigationGroup(NavigationGroup::Customers)
```

#### Evaluate user-menu visibility at render time
- **Do:** Evaluate user-menu visibility at render time.
- **Flag when:** Flag when visible/hidden receives an eagerly evaluated user permission check during menu setup.
- **Why:** A closure reads the current authenticated user when the menu actually renders.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->visible(auth()->user()->can('viewAny', Payment::class))
```

After:
```php
->visible(fn () => auth()->user()->can('viewAny', Payment::class))
```

#### Share atomic MFA state across servers
- **Do:** Use one shared cache store supporting atomic locks across all servers participating in Filament MFA.
- **Flag when:** Flag when multi-server MFA uses node-local cache or a store without required atomic lock support.
- **Why:** Challenges and replay protection must be consistent across requests handled by different servers.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Compile a custom theme for application utilities in Filament
- **Do:** Compile a custom theme for application utilities in Filament.
- **Flag when:** Flag when panel custom views use Tailwind utilities absent from the shipped default stylesheet and no custom theme scans them.
- **Why:** The default panel stylesheet cannot contain arbitrary application utility classes.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<div class="grid-cols-7">...</div> // custom view not scanned
```

After:
```php
@import 'tailwindcss';
@source '../../../../app/Filament/**/*';
@source '../../../../resources/views/filament/**/*';
```

#### Keep Filament CSS importance narrowly scoped
- **Do:** Keep Filament CSS importance narrowly scoped.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an override marks an entire rule or stylesheet important when only a specific utility needs precedence.
- **Why:** Narrow overrides avoid making later design changes unnecessarily difficult.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
.fi-btn { @apply bg-gray-50 text-black !important; }
```

After:
```php
.fi-btn { /* apply importance only to the utility that needs it */ }
```

#### Verify contrast for customized Filament colors in every state
- **Do:** Verify contrast for customized Filament colors in every state.
- **Flag when:** Flag when custom palettes or forced white button text produce inadequate contrast in light, dark, hover, or focus states.
- **Why:** Generated fallback shades do not establish that foreground and background remain readable.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->color('yellow') // custom white text override
```

After:
```php
// Retain or choose tested accessible foreground/background pairs in each mode.
```

#### Keep default Filament color maps unless requirements justify changes
- **Do:** Keep default Filament color maps unless requirements justify changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom map replaces defaults without a design-system or accessibility requirement and review.
- **Why:** Defaults reduce unnecessary palette maintenance; replacement maps need explicit contrast validation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Replace every shade by preference.
```

After:
```php
// Retain default maps or document and test the required palette.
```

#### Use Filament Heroicon enums
- **Do:** Use Filament Heroicon enums.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Filament Heroicons are referenced through unverified strings where the installed enum provides the icon.
- **Why:** Enums give checked icon names and size-aware selection.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->icon('heroicon-o-star')
```

After:
```php
->icon(Heroicon::OutlinedStar)
```

#### Namespace Filament plugin assets
- **Do:** Namespace Filament plugin assets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a plugin registers publishable assets without a package namespace and can collide with another package.
- **Why:** Package-scoped paths keep independent plugin asset files distinct.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
FilamentAsset::register($assets);
```

After:
```php
FilamentAsset::register($assets, package: 'vendor/plugin');
```

#### Ship raw plugin CSS for custom-theme integration
- **Do:** Ship raw plugin CSS for custom-theme integration.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a theme-integrated plugin ships an entire prebuilt Tailwind utility stylesheet instead of raw CSS and documented vendor @source integration.
- **Why:** The host theme can generate one consistent utility set without duplicate Tailwind output.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Ship a complete prebuilt Tailwind stylesheet in the plugin.
```

After:
```php
// Ship raw plugin CSS and document vendor view @source entries.
```

#### Provide compiled plugin styles when no custom theme is available
- **Do:** Provide compiled plugin styles when no custom theme is available.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a plugin promises operation without a host custom theme but ships no stylesheet containing its required utilities.
- **Why:** A host without a theme build cannot generate plugin utilities from raw sources.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Raw utilities require a theme the host does not build.
```

After:
```php
FilamentAsset::register([Css::make('plugin', __DIR__.'/../dist/plugin.css')], package: 'vendor/plugin');
```

#### Bundle imported JavaScript before Filament asset registration
- **Do:** Bundle imported JavaScript before Filament asset registration.
- **Flag when:** Flag when registered JavaScript contains unresolved npm imports and assumes filament:assets will bundle them.
- **Why:** The asset publisher copies files; the bundler must resolve package imports first.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Js::make('widget', resource_path('js/widget.js')) // contains bare npm imports
```

After:
```php
Js::make('widget', Vite::asset('resources/js/widget.js'))
```

#### Publish registered Filament assets during deployment
- **Do:** Run the installed Filament asset publication/upgrade lifecycle after package changes and keep filament:upgrade in Composer scripts or an equivalent deployment step.
- **Flag when:** Flag when registered or updated Filament assets are never published for the deployed package version.
- **Why:** The browser needs assets matching the deployed PHP package.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Build custom Filament themes during deployment
- **Do:** Compile custom Filament themes through the frontend build as part of deployment.
- **Flag when:** Flag when deployment runs only filament:assets and assumes it compiles custom theme CSS.
- **Why:** Publishing assets does not run the custom Tailwind/Vite theme build.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Ignore generated Filament assets in source control
- **Do:** Ignore generated Filament assets in source control.
- **Flag when:** Flag when generated public/css/filament, public/js/filament, or public/fonts/filament directories are committed under a build-on-deploy workflow.
- **Why:** Regenerating package assets prevents stale vendor output and unnecessary repository churn.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
/public/css/filament // tracked
```

After:
```php
/public/css/filament
/public/js/filament
/public/fonts/filament // .gitignore entries
```

#### Cache Filament discovery during deployment
- **Do:** Run filament:optimize after production code and assets are in place.
- **Flag when:** Flag when production deployment omits the installed Filament component/icon optimization step.
- **Why:** Discovery caches reduce repeated runtime scanning.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Keep user input out of executable JavaScript strings
- **Do:** Keep user input out of executable JavaScript strings.
- **Flag when:** Flag when actionJs or another Filament JavaScript expression concatenates user-controlled text into code.
- **Why:** Runtime values must remain data rather than becoming executable JavaScript.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->actionJs("run('".$input."')")
```

After:
```php
->actionJs('run($get("value"))')
```

#### Keep data mutations out of modal initialization
- **Do:** Keep data mutations out of modal initialization.
- **Flag when:** Flag when mountUsing or another modal initialization hook changes persistent data before submission.
- **Why:** Actions can be URL-mounted without user confirmation, so initialization must not perform the mutation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->mountUsing(fn () => $record->delete())
```

After:
```php
->requiresConfirmation()->action(fn () => $record->delete())
```

#### Halt blocked modals explicitly and recheck submission limits
- **Do:** Halt blocked modals explicitly and recheck submission limits.
- **Flag when:** Flag when mountUsing merely returns to block opening or relies on a mount-only limit for submission security.
- **Why:** Halting stops modal opening; submission still needs its own current validation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->mountUsing(function () { if (!$allowed) return; })
```

After:
```php
->mountUsing(function ($action) { if (!$allowed) $action->halt(); })
```

#### Use documented names for injected Filament closure utilities
- **Do:** Use documented names for injected Filament closure utilities.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a closure expects a utility under an unrecognized parameter name.
- **Why:** Filament injects many configuration utilities by their documented parameter names.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->visible(fn ($currentRecord) => $currentRecord->active)
```

After:
```php
->visible(fn ($record) => $record->active)
```

#### Confirm destructive Filament actions
- **Do:** Confirm destructive Filament actions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a destructive action deletes or irreversibly changes data without requiresConfirmation or equivalent deliberate confirmation.
- **Why:** Confirmation reduces accidental destructive actions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Action::make('delete')->action(fn () => $record->delete())
```

After:
```php
Action::make('delete')->requiresConfirmation()->action(fn () => $record->delete())
```

#### Initialize forms when overriding modal mount hooks
- **Do:** Initialize forms when overriding modal mount hooks.
- **Flag when:** Flag when custom mountUsing omits form fill and the modal form is uninitialized.
- **Why:** Overriding initialization replaces the default form setup.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->mountUsing(function () { /* custom setup only */ })
```

After:
```php
->mountUsing(function ($form) { $form->fill(); /* custom setup */ })
```

#### Give adjacent Filament action groups distinct labels
- **Do:** Give adjacent Filament action groups distinct labels.
- **Flag when:** Flag when multiple icon-only action group triggers have indistinguishable accessible labels.
- **Why:** Distinct labels identify which menu each trigger opens.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
ActionGroup::make($actions) // repeated unlabeled groups
```

After:
```php
ActionGroup::make($actions)->label('Invoice actions')
```

#### Report unprocessable import rows explicitly
- **Do:** Report unprocessable import rows explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an importer silently skips a failed row or throws a generic exception without a useful failed-row message.
- **Why:** A row-specific failure explains how the user can repair the import.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
if (!$valid) return;
```

After:
```php
if (!$valid) throw new RowImportFailedException('Unknown customer email');
```

#### Bound Filament import and export row counts
- **Do:** Bound Filament import and export row counts.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an unbounded import or export can queue or process a dataset beyond the application capacity.
- **Why:** Explicit row limits keep bulk operations within the intended resource budget.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
ImportAction::make()
```

After:
```php
ImportAction::make()->maxRows(10000)
```

#### Expire generated export files
- **Do:** Schedule cleanup of old Filament export files on the configured export disk using a defined retention period.
- **Flag when:** Flag when generated exports accumulate indefinitely with no cleanup or storage lifecycle rule.
- **Why:** Filament does not automatically delete the generated files.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Preserve accessible labels on visually unlabeled fields
- **Do:** Preserve accessible labels on visually unlabeled fields.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a field label is set to an empty string or removed without an equivalent accessible name.
- **Why:** A visually hidden label keeps the control identifiable to screen readers.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make('email')->label('')
```

After:
```php
TextInput::make('email')->label('Email')->hiddenLabel()
```

#### Disable mutating field actions with the field
- **Do:** Disable mutating field actions with the field.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a read-only or disabled field retains an active prefix, suffix, or extra-item action that changes its value.
- **Why:** The field state must apply to every control that can mutate it.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->disabled()->suffixAction($changeValueAction)
```

After:
```php
->disabled()->suffixAction($changeValueAction->disabled())
```

#### Do not persist security-sensitive disabled field state
- **Do:** Do not persist security-sensitive disabled field state.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a protected attribute uses disabled()->saved() or readOnly without saved(false) and trusts submitted state.
- **Why:** Disabled or read-only presentation does not make Livewire state trustworthy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make('is_admin')->disabled()->saved()
```

After:
```php
TextInput::make('is_admin')->readOnly()->saved(false)
```

#### Use client visibility for simple field display conditions
- **Do:** Use client visibility for simple field display conditions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a live server update only controls simple visibility that can be evaluated locally.
- **Why:** Client conditions avoid a network request for a presentation-only toggle.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->live() // solely to drive hidden(fn ($get) => ... )
```

After:
```php
->hiddenJs('$get("kind") !== "custom"')
```

#### Give simultaneously rendered fields distinct state paths
- **Do:** Give simultaneously rendered fields distinct state paths.
- **Flag when:** Flag when two visible fields resolve to the same full state path, including nested repeater or group prefixes.
- **Why:** Shared paths make unrelated controls overwrite the same value.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make('name'), TextInput::make('name')
```

After:
```php
TextInput::make('billing.name'), TextInput::make('shipping.name')
```

#### Read Filament form state through typed Get helpers
- **Do:** Read Filament form state through typed Get helpers.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a closure assumes a raw field value has a scalar or enum type without conversion or validation.
- **Why:** Typed access makes expected values and nullability explicit.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$quantity = $get('quantity');
```

After:
```php
$quantity = $get->integer('quantity');
```

#### Skip reactive field rendering without visible effects
- **Do:** Skip reactive field rendering without visible effects.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an afterStateUpdated hook only performs nonvisual work yet triggers a full render.
- **Why:** No HTML needs updating when the hook has no visible effect.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->afterStateUpdated(fn () => recordMetric())
```

After:
```php
->afterStateUpdated(fn () => recordMetric())->skipRenderAfterStateUpdated()
```

#### Serve Filament over HTTPS
- **Do:** Serve deployed Filament interfaces over HTTPS, including pages with clipboard features.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a deployed panel is accessible only over insecure HTTP or clipboard operations run outside a secure context.
- **Why:** Browser clipboard APIs require a secure context and administrative sessions need secure transport.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Keep searchable select result sets modest
- **Do:** Keep searchable select result sets modest.
- **Flag when:** Flag when optionsLimit is raised enough to send large result lists and create browser memory or responsiveness issues.
- **Why:** Search should retrieve a bounded useful result set rather than load all options.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->optionsLimit(100000)
```

After:
```php
->optionsLimit(50)
```

#### Validate disabled options on the server
- **Do:** Validate disabled options on the server.
- **Flag when:** Flag when disableOptionWhen changes presentation but submitted values are not restricted to enabled options.
- **Why:** A browser can submit a disabled value unless server validation rejects it.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->disableOptionWhen(fn ($value) => $value === 'admin')
```

After:
```php
->disableOptionWhen(fn ($value) => $value === 'admin')->in(fn ($component) => array_keys($component->getEnabledOptions()))
```

#### Convert display timezones while preserving the storage convention
- **Do:** Convert display timezones while preserving the storage convention.
- **Flag when:** Flag when user timezone preferences alter the storage convention or timestamps are displayed without the required UI conversion.
- **Why:** Separating storage from display avoids inconsistent timestamp interpretation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Persist the user-local wall time without conversion.
```

After:
```php
DateTimePicker::make('starts_at')->timezone($userTimezone)
```

#### Use a time-capable picker for timestamp values
- **Do:** Use a time-capable picker for timestamp values.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a date-only picker edits a value whose time or timezone conversion must be retained.
- **Why:** Date-only controls cannot preserve a meaningful time-of-day editing contract.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
DatePicker::make('starts_at')
```

After:
```php
DateTimePicker::make('starts_at')
```

#### Protect shared-disk uploads from path tampering
- **Do:** Protect shared-disk uploads from path tampering.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a shared upload disk trusts a client path outside the permitted user/tenant/record scope and relies only on directory().
- **Why:** The directory option sets storage location but does not itself authorize submitted existing paths.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
FileUpload::make('file')->directory($tenantId)
```

After:
```php
FileUpload::make('file')->directory($tenantId)->preventFilePathTampering()
```

#### Align upload size limits across all layers
- **Do:** Configure PHP upload/post limits and Livewire temporary validation together for the largest accepted upload.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the interface accepts files larger than PHP or temporary upload validation permits.
- **Why:** The lowest limit can reject the request before final application validation runs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Render private rich-editor attachments through the supported renderer
- **Do:** Render private rich-editor attachments through the supported renderer.
- **Flag when:** Flag when private rich-editor content is rendered directly without fresh temporary URLs or is stored with public attachment visibility.
- **Why:** The renderer must resolve current authorized URLs when private content is displayed.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
{!! $record->content !!}
```

After:
```php
{{ RichContentRenderer::make($record->content)->fileAttachmentsDisk('s3')->fileAttachmentsVisibility('private') }}
```

#### Reuse Filament rich editor TipTap dependencies
- **Do:** Reuse Filament rich editor TipTap dependencies.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom TipTap extension bundles another copy of @tiptap/core or @tiptap/pm.
- **Why:** Duplicate editor dependencies can create incompatible runtime instances.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
import { Extension } from '@tiptap/core';
```

After:
```php
const { Extension } = window.FilamentRichEditor.tiptap.core;
```

#### Keep private images out of MarkdownEditor uploads
- **Do:** Keep private images out of MarkdownEditor uploads.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a MarkdownEditor upload is used for private or sensitive images.
- **Why:** Its image upload path is public; a private-attachment-capable editor is needed.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
MarkdownEditor::make('private_notes')
```

After:
```php
RichEditor::make('private_notes')->fileAttachmentsVisibility('private')
```

#### Provide keyboard controls for reordering
- **Do:** Provide keyboard controls for reordering.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a reorderable Repeater or Builder offers only drag interaction.
- **Why:** Visible move controls let keyboard users perform the same ordering task.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Repeater::make('items')->reorderable()
```

After:
```php
Repeater::make('items')->reorderable()->reorderableWithButtons()
```

#### Validate ColorPicker values against the chosen format
- **Do:** Validate ColorPicker values against the chosen format.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a ColorPicker persists arbitrary strings without server format validation.
- **Why:** Client selection does not prevent tampered values.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
ColorPicker::make('color')
```

After:
```php
ColorPicker::make('color')->hexColor()
```

#### Keep custom field configuration protected with getters
- **Do:** Keep custom field configuration protected with getters.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom field exposes configuration as public properties and expects it to behave as Livewire state.
- **Why:** Configuration belongs to the field object interface, not the Livewire public-state mechanism.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public int $zoom = 10;
```

After:
```php
protected int $zoom = 10;
public function getZoom(): int { return $this->zoom; }
```

#### Use notification status helpers for standard states
- **Do:** Use notification status helpers for standard states.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a standard success/warning/danger/info notification manually duplicates the corresponding icon and color configuration.
- **Why:** Status helpers keep standard feedback consistent.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Notification::make()->icon('heroicon-o-check-circle')->color('success')
```

After:
```php
Notification::make()->success()
```

#### Keep unique actionable notifications visible until dismissed
- **Do:** Keep unique actionable notifications visible until dismissed.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a notification disappears automatically even though it contains the only available information or action.
- **Why:** Users need time to read or act on information unavailable elsewhere.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Notification::make()->title('Review required')->send()
```

After:
```php
Notification::make()->title('Review required')->persistent()->send()
```

#### Announce dynamically revealed callouts
- **Do:** Announce dynamically revealed callouts.
- **Flag when:** Flag when important dynamically added callout content has no status/alert live-region role.
- **Why:** A live region lets assistive technology announce new feedback.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Callout::make()->description('Saved')
```

After:
```php
Callout::make()->description('Saved')->extraAttributes(['role' => 'status'])
```

#### Resolve extensible component factories through the container
- **Do:** Resolve extensible component factories through the container.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a public extensible Filament make factory directly constructs the component and bypasses container replacements.
- **Why:** Container resolution preserves bindings that customize component behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return new static($name);
```

After:
```php
return app(static::class, ['name' => $name]);
```

#### Bound large-table page sizes
- **Do:** Bound large-table page sizes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a large Filament table offers all records or excessive per-page values.
- **Why:** Bounded pagination limits query, payload, and DOM costs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->paginationPageOptions([25, 1000, 'all'])
```

After:
```php
->paginationPageOptions([10, 25, 50])
```

#### Defer slow table queries behind the page shell
- **Do:** Defer slow table queries behind the page shell.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an expensive table query blocks the initial page even though deferred loading fits the screen.
- **Why:** A delayed table makes surrounding navigation and controls available sooner.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $table->columns($columns);
```

After:
```php
return $table->columns($columns)->deferLoading();
```

#### Disable costly per-word table search when unnecessary
- **Do:** Disable costly per-word table search when unnecessary.
- **Flag when:** Flag when search on a large dataset generates expensive per-word predicates without a requirement for that search behavior.
- **Why:** Searching the complete term can reduce query complexity when it matches user expectations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $table; // default term splitting on a costly search
```

After:
```php
return $table->splitSearchTerms(false);
```

#### Report each failed bulk record once and stop its processing
- **Do:** Report each failed bulk record once with reportBulkProcessingFailure(key: ..., message: ...) and immediately stop processing that record.
- **Flag when:** Flag repeated failure reports, continued mutations after failure, or a display message accidentally passed as the first positional key argument.
- **Why:** One terminal failure per record keeps counts and messages accurate.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$action->reportBulkProcessingFailure($message); // execution continues
```

After:
```php
$action->reportBulkProcessingFailure(key: 'invalid-record', message: $message);
continue;
```

#### Refresh custom-data tables after mutations
- **Do:** Refresh custom-data tables after mutations.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an action changes array-backed table data but leaves the table showing its old source state.
- **Why:** Custom data tables are not automatically refreshed like the standard query-backed flow.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$this->updateCustomRecords();
```

After:
```php
$this->updateCustomRecords();
$this->resetTable();
```

#### Set widget polling to a deliberate refresh interval
- **Do:** Set widget polling to a deliberate refresh interval.
- **Flag when:** Flag when expensive stats or charts keep the default frequent polling without a corresponding freshness need.
- **Why:** A suitable interval reduces repeated queries and server load.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected ?string $pollingInterval = '5s';
```

After:
```php
protected ?string $pollingInterval = '60s';
```

#### Apply expensive chart filters explicitly
- **Do:** Apply expensive chart filters explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when each filter edit immediately reruns a complex chart query despite an apply-on-demand interface requirement.
- **Why:** Deferred filters combine several edits into one query.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected bool $hasDeferredFilters = false;
```

After:
```php
protected bool $hasDeferredFilters = true;
```

#### Provide equivalent textual chart information
- **Do:** Provide equivalent textual chart information.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a chart contains information unavailable through its description or an accessible data alternative.
- **Why:** Users who cannot interpret the visual need the same substantive data or trends.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected ?string $description = null;
```

After:
```php
public function getChartAssistiveContent(): string { return 'January: 10 orders; February: 14 orders.'; }
```

#### Append Chart.js plugins without overwriting the registry
- **Do:** Append Chart.js plugins without overwriting the registry.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a script replaces window.filamentChartJsPlugins and removes plugins registered by another source.
- **Why:** Nullish initialization preserves all previously registered plugins.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
window.filamentChartJsPlugins = [plugin];
```

After:
```php
window.filamentChartJsPlugins ??= [];
window.filamentChartJsPlugins.push(plugin);
```

#### Authorize access to Filament settings pages
- **Do:** Authorize access to Filament settings pages.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a settings page relies only on panel membership despite settings requiring a narrower permission.
- **Why:** Settings pages need their own access boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public static function canAccess(): bool { return true; }
```

After:
```php
public static function canAccess(): bool { return auth()->user()->can('manage settings'); }
```

#### Match settings field names to settings properties
- **Do:** Match settings field names to settings properties.
- **Flag when:** Flag when settings form field names do not match the corresponding settings class properties.
- **Why:** The plugin fills and saves by matching property names.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make('site_title') // class property is siteName
```

After:
```php
TextInput::make('siteName')
```

#### Declare private media-library upload visibility
- **Do:** Declare private media-library upload visibility.
- **Flag when:** Flag when private media storage is used without private field visibility and valid temporary URL handling.
- **Why:** The field must know the media is private to generate the correct URLs.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
SpatieMediaLibraryFileUpload::make('document')
```

After:
```php
SpatieMediaLibraryFileUpload::make('document')->visibility('private')
```

#### Choose the media-library upload disk explicitly
- **Do:** Choose the media-library upload disk explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a media upload assumes the general Spatie default disk controls Filament while no field or collection disk is set.
- **Why:** An explicit field or collection disk prevents unexpected placement and visibility.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
SpatieMediaLibraryFileUpload::make('file')
```

After:
```php
SpatieMediaLibraryFileUpload::make('file')->disk('private-media')
```

#### Give rich-editor attachments a dedicated media collection
- **Do:** Register the rich content attribute on the model and give its SpatieMediaLibraryFileAttachmentProvider a dedicated collection containing only that attribute’s attachments.
- **Flag when:** Flag rich-editor attachments sharing a collection with unrelated files, or code using the absent fileAttachmentsCollection() API.
- **Why:** Editor cleanup removes unused attachments from its collection.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->fileAttachmentsCollection('all-media')
```

After:
```php
public function setUpRichContent(): void
{
    $this->registerRichContent('content')->fileAttachmentProvider(
        \Filament\Forms\Components\RichEditor\FileAttachmentProviders\SpatieMediaLibraryFileAttachmentProvider::make()
            ->collection('editor-attachments'),
    );
}
```

#### Allowlist schemes for untrusted Filament URLs
- **Do:** Allowlist schemes for untrusted Filament URLs.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a client-controlled URL reaches a Filament URL method without rejecting executable or unsupported schemes.
- **Why:** Escaping HTML alone does not make a javascript or other unsafe URL safe.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->url($submittedUrl)
```

After:
```php
->url($validatedHttpOrHttpsUrl)
```

#### Keep documented Filament extension classes subclassable
- **Do:** Keep documented Filament extension classes subclassable.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a public extension class is marked final or readonly despite documented subclass extension requirements.
- **Why:** Consumers must be able to implement the supported extension contract.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
final class CustomField extends Field {}
```

After:
```php
class CustomField extends Field {}
```

#### Compare full timestamps when the cutoff includes time
- **Do:** Compare full timestamps when the cutoff includes time.
- **Flag when:** Flag when whereDate is used for a now-relative cutoff whose time-of-day matters.
- **Why:** Discarding time broadens or narrows the intended boundary by part of a day.
- **Enforced by:** partial: rector:ChangeQueryWhereDateValueWithCarbonRector

Before:
```php
->whereDate('expires_at', '<', now())
```

After:
```php
->where('expires_at', '<', now())
```

#### Read SQL expressions through the current grammar-aware API
- **Do:** Read SQL expressions through the current grammar-aware API.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a query expression is cast to a string or calls removed __toString behavior.
- **Why:** Expression SQL can depend on the active connection grammar.
- **Enforced by:** rector:DatabaseExpressionToStringToMethodCallRector, rector:DatabaseExpressionCastsToMethodCallRector

Before:
```php
(string) $expression
```

After:
```php
$expression->getValue(DB::connection()->getQueryGrammar())
```

#### Review third-party plugin code and maintenance before installation
- **Do:** Review third-party plugin code and maintenance before installation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a plugin adoption process assumes first-party security or maintenance guarantees for a community package.
- **Why:** Third-party plugin code executes within the application and needs its own evaluation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Review production access permissions quarterly
- **Do:** Review production access permissions at least quarterly against current duties.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the production access policy has no quarterly review or recorded role assignments no longer match approved duties.
- **Why:** Periodic review catches privileges that outlast their need.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Use compiled production CSS for PDF templates
- **Do:** Use compiled production CSS for PDF templates.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a production PDF template depends on the Tailwind development CDN script rather than built CSS.
- **Why:** A compiled stylesheet avoids runtime CDN/script dependence in headless rendering.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
```

After:
```php
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ Vite::asset('resources/css/pdf.css') }}">
```

#### Annotate parameters that accept Blade view names
- **Do:** Annotate parameters that accept Blade view names.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a view-name parameter remains an unconstrained string although Larastan view-string checking is part of the project contract.
- **Why:** The specialized type lets analysis check referenced views.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
/** @param string $view */
```

After:
```php
/** @phpstan-param view-string $view */
```

#### Give each independently built module its own asset output
- **Do:** Give each independently built module its own asset output.
- **Flag when:** Flag when module builds overwrite a shared manifest/output or templates resolve assets against the wrong module build.
- **Why:** Dedicated manifests keep independently compiled module assets from colliding.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
laravel({ buildDirectory: 'build' }) // every module
```

After:
```php
laravel({ buildDirectory: 'build-orders' }) // render with matching module_vite()
```

#### Use the stable Wireable integration for Livewire data objects
- **Do:** Use the stable Wireable integration for Livewire data objects.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a laravel-data object is stored in Livewire public state without Wireable/WireableData or relies on experimental synthesizers without an explicit project decision.
- **Why:** The documented stable integration preserves data objects across hydration.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class ProfileData extends Data {}
```

After:
```php
class ProfileData extends Data implements Wireable { use WireableData; }
```

#### Authorize custom Shield pages and widgets
- **Do:** Authorize custom Shield pages and widgets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom page/widget displays or remains accessible without the intended Shield permission check.
- **Why:** Navigation visibility alone is insufficient; the page or widget needs its supported access check.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class Reports extends Page {}
```

After:
```php
class Reports extends Page { use HasPageShield; }
```

#### Prohibit destructive Shield commands in production
- **Do:** Prohibit destructive Shield commands in production.
- **Flag when:** Flag when production can execute destructive shield commands without the supported prohibition.
- **Why:** Command-level protection reduces accidental destructive permission regeneration.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// No production prohibition.
```

After:
```php
FilamentShield::prohibitDestructiveCommands($this->app->isProduction());
```

#### Use snake_case Shield permission translation keys
- **Do:** Use snake_case Shield permission translation keys.
- **Flag when:** Flag when localized Shield permission labels use keys in the configured permission case instead of the required snake_case labels.
- **Why:** Permission key formatting and translation label lookup follow separate conventions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
'viewAny' => 'View any'
```

After:
```php
'view_any' => 'View any'
```

#### Grant only the required read access to exposed logs
- **Do:** Grant only the required read access to exposed logs.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the web process cannot read intended logs or broad permission changes expose unrelated log files.
- **Why:** Targeted read ACLs give Log Viewer access without widening the whole filesystem boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Remove obsolete Log Viewer asset publishing
- **Do:** Remove obsolete Log Viewer asset publishing.
- **Flag when:** Flag when current Log Viewer setup still runs log-viewer:publish or configures the deprecated assets_path.
- **Why:** Current versions serve their matching frontend assets directly from the package.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
'assets_path' => 'vendor/log-viewer'
```

After:
```php
// Remove obsolete publishing; use the installed package asset delivery.
```

#### Use the current Log Viewer sorting enum
- **Do:** Use the current Log Viewer sorting enum.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Log Viewer configuration imports the deprecated FolderSortingMethod enum.
- **Why:** The current SortingMethod enum matches the supported configuration API.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
FolderSortingMethod::Alphabetical
```

After:
```php
SortingMethod::Alphabetical
```

#### Keep Log Viewer defaults within allowed page sizes
- **Do:** Keep Log Viewer defaults within allowed page sizes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the default per-page count is absent from the configured selectable page sizes.
- **Why:** Consistent pagination configuration prevents invalid or confusing page state.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
'per_page_options' => [10, 25, 50], 'defaults' => ['per_page' => 100]
```

After:
```php
'per_page_options' => [10, 25, 50], 'defaults' => ['per_page' => 25]
```

#### Keep generated dummy logs out of production
- **Do:** Keep generated dummy logs out of production.
- **Flag when:** Flag when production workflows run Log Viewer dummy-log generation.
- **Why:** Synthetic log entries pollute operational evidence and can consume storage.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Compose complex fields from focused subcomponents
- **Do:** Compose complex fields from focused subcomponents.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a field component accumulates many unrelated configuration flags to control label, description, input, and error variants.
- **Why:** Focused parts permit useful combinations without an expanding boolean API.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<x-input :has-label="true" :has-description="true" :compact="true" />
```

After:
```php
<x-field><x-label>Email</x-label><x-input /><x-description>Work address</x-description></x-field>
```

#### Expose responsive dimensions through CSS custom properties
- **Do:** Expose responsive dimensions through CSS custom properties.
- **Flag when:** Flag when fixed-size component props prevent responsive widths or heights without custom variant proliferation.
- **Why:** Custom properties can vary by breakpoint while preserving a stable component interface.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<x-dialog size="400px" />
```

After:
```php
<x-dialog class="[--dialog-width:20rem] md:[--dialog-width:40rem]" />
```

#### Keep a consistent Livewire member order
- **Do:** Keep a consistent Livewire member order.
- **Flag when:** Flag when component properties, hooks, actions, helpers, and render methods are arranged inconsistently with the project convention.
- **Why:** A stable order makes component behavior easier to navigate.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Actions, properties, hooks, and helpers interleaved arbitrarily.
```

After:
```php
public string $title = '';
public function mount(): void {}
public function save(): void {}
protected function normalize(): void {}
public function render() { return view('livewire.editor'); }
```

#### Disable Herd view debugging when it is not in use
- **Do:** Disable Herd view debugging when it is not in use.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Herd view debugging dumps stay enabled during ordinary development and significantly slow rendering.
- **Why:** Debug instrumentation can add unnecessary work to every rendered view.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Pin real downstream compatibility fixtures and review baseline changes
- **Do:** Pin real downstream compatibility fixtures and review baseline changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when compatibility CI uses moving downstream revisions or accepts changed baselines without reviewing user-visible behavior.
- **Why:** Pinned projects make regressions reproducible and prevent fixture drift from disguising a breaking change.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Review rendered controls through the accessibility tree
- **Do:** Review rendered controls through the accessibility tree.
