- **Flag when:** Flag when a taint-escape extraction introduces a redundant scalar cast rejected by analysis.
- **Why:** Explicit conversion can satisfy the escape placement without a redundant-cast warning.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
/** @psalm-taint-escape html */ $safe = (string) $alreadyString;
```

After:
```php
/** @psalm-taint-escape html */ $safe = strval($alreadyString);
```

#### Prefer narrow escapes to broad taint suppression
- **Do:** Use a kind-specific taint escape before resorting to psalm-suppress TaintedInput when practical.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a broad TaintedInput suppression could be replaced with a local kind-specific escape without meaningful code changes.
- **Why:** A narrow escape retains unrelated taint checks.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
/** @psalm-suppress TaintedInput */
```

After:
```php
/** @psalm-taint-escape html */
```

#### Use semantic theme colors
- **Do:** Use named NativePHP semantic theme tokens for native chrome and define the required roles in both light and dark theme maps in config/native-ui.php.
- **Flag when:** Flag hard-coded native chrome colors, theme roles missing from either theme map, or bare bg-theme/text-theme classes without a named token.
- **Why:** Shared tokens keep theme behavior consistent.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
class="bg-white text-black"
```

After:
```php
class="bg-theme-surface text-theme-on-surface border-theme-outline"
```

#### Represent unreported AI usage as unknown rather than zero
- **Do:** Represent unreported AI usage as unknown rather than zero.

- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php

```

After:
```php

```

#### Price cached and uncached AI input tokens separately
- **Do:** Price cached reads, cached writes and uncached AI input separately using TextUsage; preserve an unknown cost when the provider omits a required count instead of treating null as measured zero.
- **Flag when:** Flag total-input pricing with one rate despite distinct cache prices, or direct arithmetic on nullable usage counts that reports unknown usage as zero cost.
- **Why:** Cache reads, writes and uncached inputs have different billing semantics.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$cost = $usage->inputTokens * $inputRate;
```

After:
```php
$uncached = $usage->uncachedInputTokens();
$read = $usage->cacheReadInputTokens;
$write = $usage->cacheWriteInputTokens;
$cost = ($uncached === null || $read === null || $write === null)
    ? null
    : $uncached * $inputRate + $read * $readRate + $write * $writeRate;
```

#### Revoke Passport tokens through revocation APIs rather than display expiry columns
- **Do:** Revoke Passport tokens through revocation APIs rather than display expiry columns.
- **Flag when:** Flag when code edits tokens.expires_at to invalidate an already signed access token.
- **Why:** The signed token carries its expiry; changing display data does not revoke it.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$token->update(["expires_at" => now()]);
```

After:
```php
$token->revoke();
```

#### Revoke refresh credentials alongside an access token
- **Do:** Revoke refresh credentials alongside an access token.
- **Flag when:** Flag when access-token revocation leaves its refresh token usable.
- **Why:** A refresh token can otherwise obtain a replacement access token.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$token->revoke();
```

After:
```php
$token->revoke(); $token->refreshToken?->revoke();
```

#### Schedule cleanup of expired and revoked OAuth records
- **Do:** Schedule cleanup of expired and revoked OAuth records.
- **Flag when:** Flag when expired/revoked Passport tokens and authorization/device codes grow without cleanup.
- **Why:** Purging reduces retained credential metadata and storage.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// No Passport cleanup schedule.
```

After:
```php
Schedule::command("passport:purge")->hourly();
```

#### Respect OAuth device-flow polling intervals
- **Do:** Respect OAuth device-flow polling intervals.
- **Flag when:** Flag when device token polling ignores interval or slow_down responses.
- **Why:** Backoff avoids unnecessary load and protocol rate errors.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
while (! $token) pollToken();
```

After:
```php
// Wait the returned interval and increase it when slow_down is returned.
```

#### Choose a modern OAuth grant instead of the password grant
- **Do:** Choose a modern OAuth grant instead of the password grant.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an application introduces Passport password-grant flows.
- **Why:** The password grant exposes user credentials to clients and is no longer recommended.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Passport::enablePasswordGrant();
```

After:
```php
// Use authorization code with PKCE, or device authorization for limited-input clients.
```

#### Authenticate client-credential routes as clients rather than users
- **Do:** Authenticate client-credential routes as clients rather than users.
- **Flag when:** Flag when machine-to-machine tokens use a user-authentication middleware path.
- **Why:** Client identity must not be confused with user identity.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::middleware("auth:api")->get("/machine", $handler);
```

After:
```php
Route::middleware(EnsureClientIsResourceOwner::class)->get("/machine", $handler);
```

#### Keep Passport UUID client identifiers
- **Do:** Keep Passport UUID client identifiers.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Passport client UUIDs are disabled and client IDs can collide with user IDs.
- **Why:** Colliding identifiers can confuse client and resource-owner resolution.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Passport::$clientUuids = false;
```

After:
```php
// Keep the default UUID client identifiers enabled.
```

#### Give OAuth scopes clear consent-screen descriptions
- **Do:** Give OAuth scopes clear consent-screen descriptions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when requested scopes have no meaningful user-facing description.
- **Why:** Users need to understand the access they grant.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Passport::tokensCan(["orders:read" => "Scope 1"]);
```

After:
```php
Passport::tokensCan(["orders:read" => "Read your orders"]);
```

#### Enforce required Passport scopes on authenticated routes
- **Do:** Enforce required Passport scopes on authenticated routes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a scoped OAuth endpoint checks user authentication but not its required token scope.
- **Why:** Token scopes constrain delegated access independently of user identity.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::middleware("auth:api")->get("/orders", $handler);
```

After:
```php
Route::middleware(["auth:api", CheckToken::using("orders:read")])->get("/orders", $handler);
```

#### Use Passport automatic route registration rather than duplicating its endpoints
- **Do:** Use Passport automatic route registration rather than duplicating its endpoints.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the app manually registers duplicate OAuth package routes.
- **Why:** Duplicate routes can diverge from package middleware and validation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::post("/oauth/token", $customPackageAlias);
```

After:
```php
// Use Passport registered routes; override only through supported customization.
```

#### Combine account throttling, MFA and appropriate edge protection
- **Do:** Combine account throttling, MFA and appropriate edge protection.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a high-risk public login relies on one defense despite requiring layered protection.
- **Why:** Independent controls reduce brute force and account-compromise risks.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Separate cached reset-token data from disposable application cache
- **Do:** Separate cached reset-token data from disposable application cache.
- **Flag when:** Flag when cache:clear can erase active reset tokens in the shared default cache store.
- **Why:** A dedicated store avoids unrelated cache maintenance invalidating recovery.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
"driver" => "cache", "store" => "redis",
```

After:
```php
"driver" => "cache", "store" => "password_resets",
```

#### Use provider test credentials and failure cases for billing tests
- **Do:** Use the provider sandbox, test credentials and documented failure fixtures for billing tests.
- **Flag when:** Flag when billing tests invoke live payment methods or exercise only successful charges.
- **Why:** Provider test fixtures cover denials safely.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Charge a real payment method from tests.
```

After:
```php
// Use Stripe test tokens/cards for successful, declined and authentication-required payments.
```

#### Use end-to-end encrypted private broadcasts when the provider must not read payloads
- **Do:** Use end-to-end encrypted private broadcasts when the provider must not read payloads.
- **Flag when:** Flag when sensitive events pass through a third-party broker in plaintext despite a confidentiality requirement.
- **Why:** Private-channel authorization alone does not hide payloads from the service.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return new PrivateChannel("account.".$id);
```

After:
```php
return new EncryptedPrivateChannel("account.".$id);
```

#### Keep Mercure hub and application signing configuration aligned
- **Do:** Keep Mercure hub and application signing configuration aligned.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the hub and publisher use different JWT secrets or incorrect internal/public URLs.
- **Why:** Credential and URL mismatches break authenticated publishing/subscription.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Use per-response CSP nonces consistently in headers and generated assets
- **Do:** Use per-response CSP nonces consistently in headers and generated assets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when asset nonce attributes are emitted without a matching CSP header or reuse a fixed nonce.
- **Why:** A nonce must be fresh and included in the enforcing policy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Vite::useCspNonce("fixed");
```

After:
```php
Vite::useCspNonce(); $response->headers->set("Content-Security-Policy", "script-src 'nonce-".Vite::cspNonce()."'");
```

#### Disable password authentication in passwordless WorkOS deployments
- **Do:** Disable password authentication in passwordless WorkOS deployments.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a passwordless WorkOS app leaves Email + Password enabled in AuthKit.
- **Why:** The provider settings should match the promised passwordless authentication policy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Ignore only nonsecurity query parameters during signed-URL validation
- **Do:** Ignore only nonsecurity query parameters during signed-URL validation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when ignored parameters control resource identity, permissions or another trusted decision.
- **Why:** Ignored values can be modified without invalidating the signature.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$request->hasValidSignatureWhileIgnoring(["user_id"]);
```

After:
```php
$request->hasValidSignatureWhileIgnoring(["page", "utm_source"]);
```

#### Return a clear expired-link response for invalid signatures
- **Do:** Return a clear expired-link response for invalid signatures.
- **Flag when:** Flag when invalid/expired signed links expose a generic internal error or unclear recovery path.
- **Why:** A deliberate error response helps legitimate users recover.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Unhandled invalid signature error page.
```

After:
```php
$exceptions->render(fn (InvalidSignatureException $e) => response()->view("errors.link-expired", [], 403));
```

#### Keep database server versions within the framework support matrix
- **Do:** Keep database server versions within the framework support matrix.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a deployment uses an unsupported database version without a compatibility/maintenance plan.
- **Why:** Unsupported engines may lack required behavior and security maintenance.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Enable authentication before exposing a Sail MongoDB service
- **Do:** Enable authentication before exposing a Sail MongoDB service.
- **Flag when:** Flag when MongoDB is reachable outside the isolated dev network with default disabled authentication.
- **Why:** Unauthenticated exposure permits arbitrary data access.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Delegate hash-format detection to the configured hasher
- **Do:** Delegate hash-format detection to the configured hasher.
- **Flag when:** Flag when custom casts hard-code password_get_info despite support for alternate hashing drivers.
- **Why:** Driver-aware detection preserves custom algorithm behavior.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
password_get_info($value)["algo"] !== null
```

After:
```php
Hash::isHashed($value)
```

#### Use password-dependent session authentication only for accounts with valid password credentials
- **Do:** Use password-dependent session authentication only for accounts with valid password credentials.
- **Flag when:** Flag when AuthenticateSession is enabled for passwordless accounts without a compatible credential model.
- **Why:** The middleware relies on password state to detect changed credentials.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::middleware(AuthenticateSession::class)->group($passwordlessRoutes);
```

After:
```php
// Use an explicit passwordless session-revocation design instead of password-hash comparisons.
```

#### Support a bounded compatible transition for planned authentication-format changes
- **Do:** Support a bounded compatible transition for planned authentication-format changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a nonsecurity format migration invalidates all existing sessions unintentionally.
- **Why:** A bounded dual-format rollout can preserve continuity when old formats remain safe.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Reject all old-format tokens immediately during a compatibility-only rollout.
```

After:
```php
// Accept safe old/new formats for a fixed migration period, then retire the old format.
```

#### Do not restore vulnerable legacy remember-cookie acceptance after security hardening
- **Do:** Do not restore vulnerable legacy remember-cookie acceptance after security hardening.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a compatibility workaround accepts cookies deliberately invalidated by a security fix.
- **Why:** An attacker holding the old cookie would retain access.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Accept pre-hardening remember cookie formats indefinitely.
```

After:
```php
// Require reauthentication for formats invalidated by the security upgrade.
```

#### Avoid password-dependent remember-me credentials for passwordless accounts without a revocation design
- **Do:** Avoid password-dependent remember-me credentials for passwordless accounts without a revocation design.
- **Flag when:** Flag when passwordless accounts receive remember cookies whose validity cannot be revoked through supported credential state.
- **Why:** Remember credentials must have a reliable invalidation mechanism.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Remember cookie on an account with no password or revocation state.
```

After:
```php
// Disable remember-me or provide a supported independently revocable credential design.
```

#### Align secure generated-password character classes with validation rules
- **Do:** Align secure generated-password character classes with validation rules.
- **Flag when:** Flag when generated passwords can fail the configured required character classes.
- **Why:** Generation and validation should implement the same policy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Str::password(symbols: false); // server requires symbols
```

After:
```php
Str::password(32, letters: true, numbers: true, symbols: true, spaces: false);
```

#### Use an audited custom secure generator only for requirements beyond supported helpers
- **Do:** Use an audited custom secure generator only for requirements beyond supported helpers.
- **Flag when:** Flag when unsupported complexity requirements are assumed to be guaranteed by Str::password.
- **Why:** Custom generation still needs cryptographic randomness and adequate entropy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Assume Str::password guarantees three symbols.
```

After:
```php
// Use an audited CSPRNG generator that explicitly satisfies the additional counts.
```

#### Use a custom cast for column-specific JSON encoding choices
- **Do:** Use a custom cast for column-specific JSON encoding choices.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a global Casts\Json::encodeUsing change is introduced for one field.
- **Why:** Global changes affect unrelated JSON attributes.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Json::encodeUsing($oneColumnsEncoder);
```

After:
```php
protected function casts(): array { return ["options" => OptionsJsonCast::class]; }
```

#### Return authorization responses from policies instead of aborting directly
- **Do:** Return authorization responses from policies instead of aborting directly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when policy code aborts with a status and bypasses authorization exception context.
- **Why:** Authorization responses preserve denial details for the framework handler.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
abort(404);
```

After:
```php
return Response::denyAsNotFound();
```

#### Emit Vite asset integrity attributes from a trusted manifest
- **Do:** Emit Vite asset integrity attributes from a trusted manifest.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an adopted SRI policy omits integrity for built Vite assets.
- **Why:** Manifest integrity ties loaded bytes to the build artifact.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
plugins: [laravel(/* ... */)]
```

After:
```php
plugins: [laravel(/* ... */), manifestSRI()]
```

#### Budget Precognition validation traffic separately from mutation abuse
- **Do:** Budget Precognition validation traffic separately from mutation abuse.
- **Flag when:** Flag when live validation exhausts ordinary endpoint limits during normal typing or bypasses final-action limits.
- **Why:** Precognitive requests add volume without performing the final mutation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// One tiny budget for keystrokes and final writes.
```

After:
```php
// Choose limits that permit expected validation traffic while protecting final submissions.
```

#### Use typed middleware parameter helpers when adopting typed route declarations
- **Do:** Use typed middleware parameter helpers when adopting typed route declarations.
- **Flag when:** Flag when parameterized middleware strings violate the repository typed-middleware convention.
- **Why:** Typed helpers improve refactoring and static navigation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->middleware("can:update,post")
```

After:
```php
->middleware(Authorize::using("update", "post"))
```

#### Require the Passport guard on endpoints accepting OAuth user tokens
- **Do:** Require the Passport guard on endpoints accepting OAuth user tokens.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a protected Passport user endpoint has no matching authentication guard.
- **Why:** The endpoint must validate the supplied user access token.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::get("/profile", $handler);
```

After:
```php
Route::get("/profile", $handler)->middleware("auth:api");
```

#### Give each independent rate-limit window a distinct key namespace
- **Do:** Give each independent rate-limit window a distinct key namespace.
- **Flag when:** Flag when multiple limits use identical subject keys and unintentionally share counters.
- **Why:** Separate namespaces preserve each limit independent budget.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return [Limit::perMinute(10)->by($id), Limit::perHour(100)->by($id)];
```

After:
```php
return [Limit::perMinute(10)->by("minute:".$id), Limit::perHour(100)->by("hour:".$id)];
```

#### Count only the relevant outcomes in response-based abuse limits
- **Do:** Count only the relevant outcomes in response-based abuse limits.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an outcome-specific budget counts unrelated success/failure responses or misses the target outcome.
- **Why:** Response-aware limits can constrain enumeration without penalizing intended traffic.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Count every request against a missing-record budget.
```

After:
```php
Limit::perMinute(10)->after(fn ($response) => $response->status() === 404);
```

#### Authorize parent-child relationships in nested broadcast channels
- **Do:** Authorize parent-child relationships in nested broadcast channels.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a nested channel assumes model binding proves the child belongs to the parent.
- **Why:** Broadcast model binding does not automatically scope nested relationships.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $user->can("view", $post); // no parent check
```

After:
```php
return $post->team_id === $team->id && $user->can("view", $post);
```

#### Use atomic attempt counts for strict high-concurrency rate-limit decisions
- **Do:** Use atomic attempt counts for strict high-concurrency rate-limit decisions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when separate check-then-increment calls let concurrent requests exceed a strict quota.
- **Why:** An atomic increment result avoids the race in the decision boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
if (! RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($key, 10)) RateLimiter::increment($key);
```

After:
```php
if (RateLimiter::increment($key) > 10) abort(429);
```

#### Authorize each selected record for Filament bulk operations
- **Do:** Authorize each selected record for Filament bulk operations.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a bulk action checks only deleteAny-style access but requires per-record permissions.
- **Why:** Selection and collection-level permission do not authorize every row.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
DeleteBulkAction::make()
```

After:
```php
DeleteBulkAction::make()->authorizeIndividualRecords()
```

#### Re-query and reauthorize Livewire models before each sensitive action
- **Do:** Re-query and reauthorize Livewire models before each sensitive action.
- **Flag when:** Flag when restored public models are used without current tenant/ownership/policy checks.
- **Why:** Restored models may bypass query scopes or have changed since the previous request.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function delete() { $this->record->delete(); }
```

After:
```php
public function delete() { $record = Post::whereBelongsTo(auth()->user())->findOrFail($this->recordId); Gate::authorize("delete", $record); $record->delete(); }
```

#### Allowlist schemes before rendering untrusted navigation URLs
- **Do:** Allowlist navigation URL schemes before rendering untrusted links. In Filament use its registered Str::sanitizeUrl macro; elsewhere use a configured application sanitizer with an explicit scheme policy.
- **Flag when:** Flag untrusted navigation URLs without scheme validation, or calls to Str::sanitizeUrl in applications without Filament Support or an equivalent registered macro.
- **Why:** HTML escaping alone does not make a dangerous URL safe.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->url($record->url)
```

After:
```php
// Filament Support registers this macro.
->url(\Illuminate\Support\Str::sanitizeUrl($record->url))
```

#### Sanitize untrusted CSS colors and cast numeric style values
- **Do:** Sanitize untrusted CSS colors and cast numeric style values before rendering; use Filament Support's Str::sanitizeCssColor macro in Filament, or a configured application sanitizer elsewhere.
- **Flag when:** Flag arbitrary strings interpolated as CSS colors or numbers, or use of Str::sanitizeCssColor without its providing package or an equivalent registered macro.
- **Why:** CSS values need context-specific validation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
style="color: {!! $color !!}"
```

After:
```php
{{-- Filament Support registers the color sanitizer macro. --}}
<div style="color: {{ \Illuminate\Support\Str::sanitizeCssColor($color) }}; width: {{ (int) $width }}px"></div>
```

#### Return generic internal errors outside debug environments
- **Do:** Return generic internal errors outside debug environments.
- **Flag when:** Flag when production API errors include exception details or stack traces.
- **Why:** Clients should not receive internal configuration or implementation data.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return response()->json(["error" => $e->getMessage()], 500);
```

After:
```php
return response()->json(["error" => "Internal server error"], 500);
```

#### Prefer short-lived workflow GITHUB_TOKEN over long-lived package CI secrets
- **Do:** Prefer short-lived workflow GITHUB_TOKEN over long-lived package CI secrets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a workflow stores a long-lived repository token for actions the built-in token can perform.
- **Why:** Short-lived scoped credentials reduce persistent secret exposure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Mark initial-only body scripts to run once across navigation
- **Do:** Mark initial-only body scripts to run once across navigation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a body script with one-time setup reruns on every client navigation.
- **Why:** Repeated initialization can duplicate handlers and state.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<script>initializeGlobalSdk()</script>
```

After:
```php
<script data-navigate-once>initializeGlobalSdk()</script>
```

#### Key Composer CI caches by runtime and dependency definition
- **Do:** Key Composer CI caches by runtime and dependency definition.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a shared Composer cache key ignores incompatible PHP/Laravel/dependency changes.
- **Why:** A scoped key avoids stale or incompatible dependency artifacts.
- **Enforced by:** partial: shift:public/ci/composer-cache

#### Check permissions rather than hard-coded roles where possible
- **Do:** Check permissions rather than hard-coded roles where possible.
- **Flag when:** Flag when views/policies/controllers tie feature access directly to role names.
- **Why:** Permission names express capabilities and allow roles to evolve.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $user->hasRole("editor");
```

After:
```php
return $user->can("Update:Post");
```

#### Test authorization with the application declared roles and permissions
- **Do:** Test authorization with the application declared roles and permissions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when tests invent factory roles/permissions that do not match production seed data.
- **Why:** Tests should exercise the actual permission vocabulary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Role::factory()->create();
```

After:
```php
$this->seed(RolesAndPermissionsSeeder::class);
```

#### Dispatch domain events independently of notification preferences
- **Do:** Dispatch domain events independently of notification preferences.
- **Flag when:** Flag when muting notifications suppresses a domain event needed by other listeners.
- **Why:** Notification delivery is one consequence rather than the event itself.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
if ($notify) event(new OrderPaid($order));
```

After:
```php
event(new OrderPaid($order)); // notification listener checks preferences
```

#### Fail explicitly when a configured security control cannot be applied
- **Do:** Fail explicitly when a configured security control cannot be applied.
- **Flag when:** Flag when requested encryption/signing fails and processing continues with an unprotected artifact.
- **Why:** Silent fallback violates the configured protection guarantee.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
if (! $zip->setEncryptionName($name, $algo, $password)) { /* continue */ }
```

After:
```php
if (! $zip->setEncryptionName($name, $algo, $password)) throw new RuntimeException("Encryption failed");
```

#### Scope relationship aggregates to authorized related records
- **Do:** Scope relationship aggregates to authorized related records.
- **Flag when:** Flag when counts/sums include related data the actor is not allowed to observe.
- **Why:** Aggregates can reveal protected data without returning full records.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
User::withCount("privateDocuments")->get();
```

After:
```php
User::withCount(["privateDocuments" => fn ($q) => $q->visibleTo($actor)])->get();
```

#### Propagate invalidation dependencies through nested cached values
- **Do:** Propagate invalidation dependencies through nested cached values.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an outer cached value survives changes to data used by an inner cached computation.
- **Why:** Nested caches need shared invalidation metadata to avoid stale results.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Outer cache ignores dependencies recorded by inner cache.
```

After:
```php
// Merge inner dependency tags into the outer cache metadata.
```

#### Authorize AI conversation ownership before continuing it
- **Do:** Authorize AI conversation ownership before continuing it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when continue/continueOrStart receives a conversation ID without an actor ownership/policy check.
- **Why:** These continuation APIs do not establish that the caller owns the conversation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$agent->continue($conversationId);
```

After:
```php
Gate::authorize("view", $conversation); $agent->continue($conversation->id);
```

#### Link external MCP accounts only with user consent and user-bound token storage
- **Do:** Link external MCP accounts only with user consent and user-bound token storage.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an OAuth-linked external account is attached to the wrong user or without the required consent flow.
- **Why:** Delegated access must remain bound to the user who authorized it.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Save callback tokens to a global shared account.
```

After:
```php
// Require authenticated account linking and persist encrypted tokens under the consenting user.
```

#### Issue a fresh challenge for each wallet login attempt
- **Do:** Generate a fresh cryptographically random wallet-login challenge for each attempt, bind it to the server-side session and intended sign-in context, and consume it after successful verification.
- **Flag when:** Flag when wallet login reuses a fixed signed message or accepts a previously completed challenge again.
- **Why:** Fresh single-use challenges prevent a previously captured wallet signature from serving as a reusable login credential.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Resolve wallet accounts by the verified wallet identity
- **Do:** After server-side signature verification, resolve or create the local account using the verified wallet address in its intended network/identity namespace; require email/password only when the product actually offers and verifies those credentials.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a wallet login trusts an unverified submitted address or requires invented email/password values merely to fit a password-based user model.
- **Why:** The verified wallet identity is the authentication subject for a wallet flow and should map consistently to one intended local account.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Restrict passwordless privilege escalation for hosted applications
- **Do:** Do not give application/service users unrestricted passwordless sudo. Where deployment automation needs privilege, grant only the specific reviewed commands/capabilities required by that workflow.
- **Flag when:** Flag a web or deployment account with unrestricted NOPASSWD: ALL access without an intentionally isolated privileged-administration role.
- **Why:** Compromise of an application account should not automatically grant root control of the host.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Test policy decisions for representative roles and ownership
- **Do:** Exercise policy ability methods with representative allowed and denied users, including ownership/role differences; keep endpoint coverage where middleware, Gate hooks or binding affect the final decision.
- **Flag when:** Flag when policy logic has only an allowed-user test or is tested solely through a broad route scenario that cannot identify the failing policy condition.
- **Why:** Focused decision cases expose incorrect permissions while integration cases verify how the policy is applied.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Audit authorization decisions through GateEvaluated when required
- **Do:** When the audit contract requires authorization-decision history, listen to GateEvaluated and retain the actor, ability, relevant resource reference and allow/deny outcome without logging secrets from arbitrary arguments.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the audit trail records protected actions but omits required denied/allowed policy outcomes or cannot identify which ability was evaluated.
- **Why:** Decision records explain whether access matched the intended permissions and help investigate policy errors.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Supply custom CI-action configuration through explicit bindings
- **Do:** Pass custom action configuration through documented workflow inputs/environment bindings, using CI secret references for credentials and ordinary values for nonsensitive configuration rather than embedding deployment values in the action implementation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a reusable custom action hard-codes target-specific settings or credentials that should be supplied by its invoking workflow.
- **Why:** Explicit bindings make the action reusable and keep secrets under the CI platform's credential controls.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Negotiate ESI support before emitting surrogate instructions
- **Do:** Emit ESI tags and the appropriate Surrogate-Control instructions only when the trusted reverse proxy advertises supported ESI capability; otherwise use the ordinary non-ESI rendering path.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an application sends unprocessed ESI markup to clients or assumes every intermediary performs fragment expansion.
- **Why:** Capability negotiation lets the proxy expand fragments while preserving a usable response without ESI support.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Apply an explicit integrity policy to optional tracking scripts
- **Do:** For applications adopting a strict third-party script-integrity policy, admit optional marketing/tracking scripts only when they can meet the required pinning and integrity controls; decline an integration that requires an unreviewed mutable script exception.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an optional tracking integration silently bypasses the application's declared script-integrity requirement because its provider changes script contents.
- **Why:** An optional integration should not quietly weaken the application's chosen third-party code trust policy.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Remove server secrets from distributed NativePHP bundles
- **Do:** Treat NativePHP application code and bundled environment files as readable by the recipient. Remove server-only credentials from the build artifact and keep privileged provider operations behind an authenticated server API.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a distributable NativePHP artifact contains production backend credentials or assumes its bundled .env is confidential.
- **Why:** A distributed application cannot protect a shared server secret merely by packaging it inside its binary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Set a deliberate maximum AI output-token budget
- **Do:** Set a task-appropriate maximum output-token limit on AI generation requests, including streaming requests, and handle truncation or length-limit completion as an incomplete result when the contract requires completeness.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an AI call relies on an unnecessarily large provider default or accepts a token-truncated result as complete.
- **Why:** An explicit output budget bounds generation cost and response size.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$client->generate($prompt); // Unexamined output allowance.
```

After:
```php
#[MaxTokens(1024)] // Task-sized output allowance on a Laravel AI agent.
```

#### Choose serving regions from interactive round-trip latency
- **Do:** When measured network round trips dominate Livewire or similar server-driven interactions, serve the application near its primary users and provide loading feedback. Adopt multiple regions only with a deliberate shared-state and data-locality design.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a latency-sensitive interactive flow is served far from its users and measured network delay is left unaddressed, or extra same-region replicas are assumed to reduce geographic latency.
- **Why:** More application capacity does not remove the network delay of each server interaction.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Measure AI input using the target model tokenization
- **Do:** Use a tokenizer or token-count API matching the selected model when enforcing its input/context limit. Budget instructions, conversation, tool definitions and expected output, then chunk or reject oversized input.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a model input limit is enforced using character counts, a fixed word ratio or an unrelated model tokenizer.
- **Why:** Different models tokenize the same text differently, and the complete request consumes more context than the latest user text.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$tokens = strlen($text) / 4; // Treated as an exact model limit.
```

After:
```php
$tokens = $tokenCounter->forModel($model)->count($completeInput); // Use the matching supported tokenizer/count API.
```

#### Limit unlocked recipient keys to an active authorized session
- **Do:** For an explicitly password-unlocked per-user encryption design, use a vetted password-derived key-wrapping implementation and keep the unlocked private key only in protected session-scoped storage. Remove it on logout/expiry and define password-change and recovery rewrapping behavior.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a recipient private key is stored unwrapped indefinitely, copied into a client-visible/session-cookie payload, or remains usable after the intended session expires.
- **Why:** A bounded unlock lifetime reduces plaintext key exposure; key recovery and password changes must not silently destroy decryption access.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Store the recipient private key unencrypted in a permanent user record.
```

After:
```php
Use the vetted library to wrap the private key at rest, unlock it into protected server-side session storage and clear it when that session ends.
```

#### Use role key envelopes when encrypted access is granted by role
- **Do:** For a vetted encryption design whose record access follows stable roles, wrap record data keys to a role key and grant each authorized user access to that role key, instead of adding every new user to every historical record envelope. Define role removal and key rotation as part of the design.
- **Flag when:** Flag when onboarding a role member requires rewrapping every historical record despite a role-level access model, or removed members retain usable role-key access without a revocation plan.
- **Why:** A role envelope reduces grant fan-out while preserving an explicit cryptographic membership boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
For each new role member, add a user envelope to every historical record.
```

After:
```php
Wrap record keys to the role and grant the member a user-protected role-key envelope through the vetted provider.
```

#### Bound tool-calling AI generation steps
- **Do:** Set a deliberate finite maximum generation/tool-call step count for each tool-calling workflow and handle budget exhaustion. Size the ceiling for expected tool and repair work instead of allowing unbounded loops.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an agent can repeatedly call tools without a defined step ceiling or treats reaching the ceiling as a completed business operation.
- **Why:** A finite step budget bounds repeated tool effects, latency and token spend.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
while ($response->hasToolCalls()) { /* No work ceiling. */ }
```

After:
```php
#[MaxSteps(5)] // Deliberate ceiling; handle an unfinished workflow when exhausted.
```

#### Minimize persisted provider tokens
- **Do:** Store OAuth access and refresh tokens only when the application needs provider API access.
- **Flag when:** Flag when social sign-in persists provider tokens that are never used afterward.
- **Why:** Unused stored credentials increase exposure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$user->update(["provider_token" => $providerUser->token]);
```

After:
```php
$user->update(["provider_id" => $providerUser->getId()]);
```

#### Group shared route permissions
- **Do:** Apply shared authorization middleware to a route group when every route requires the same permission.
- **Flag when:** Flag when many related routes repeat the identical permission middleware individually.
- **Why:** A group keeps the shared boundary visible and reduces omissions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Route::get("/a", A::class)->middleware("can:manage"); Route::get("/b", B::class)->middleware("can:manage");
```

After:
```php
Route::middleware("can:manage")->group(function () { Route::get("/a", A::class); Route::get("/b", B::class); });
```

#### Set browser security headers
- **Do:** Configure CSP, anti-framing, nosniff and referrer policy headers appropriate to the application.
- **Flag when:** Flag when browser responses omit an explicit policy for these protections.
- **Why:** Headers constrain browser behavior and reduce common injection and framing exposure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Memoize repeated request-local lookups before adding cross-request cache
- **Do:** Memoize repeated request-local lookups before adding cross-request cache.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the same lookup repeats during one request or uses a global cache unnecessarily.
- **Why:** Request-local memoization avoids repeated work without stale cross-request state.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Gate::define("view", fn ($u) => Team::find($u->team_id)->active);
```

After:
```php
// Resolve the current team once in a request-scoped service used by the gate.
```

#### Keep privilege flags out of public mass-assignment allowlists
- **Do:** Keep administrative and other privileged fields out of public mass-assignment allowlists, declaring allowed request fields with Laravel 13's Fillable attribute.
- **Flag when:** Flag models filled from public forms whose Fillable declaration includes privilege flags, or legacy allowlist examples when adopting the Laravel 13 skeleton conventions.
- **Why:** A broad allowlist can elevate privileges when a caller accepts extra fields.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;

#[Fillable(["name", "is_admin"])]
class User extends \Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User {}
```

After:
```php
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\Fillable;

#[Fillable(["name"])]
class User extends \Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User {}
```

#### Scan current files and history for exposed secrets
- **Do:** Scan current files and history for exposed secrets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when CI/repository protection lacks secret scanning or only scans the working tree after a leak.
- **Why:** History and incoming commits can contain live credentials missed by manual review.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Avoid static SRI hashes on provider-managed mutable scripts
- **Do:** Avoid static SRI hashes on provider-managed mutable scripts.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an integration pins a hash for a provider URL that changes without versioning.
- **Why:** A stale hash blocks the legitimate script; use the provider supported loading model or immutable assets.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<script src="https://provider.example/dynamic.js" integrity="sha384-old"></script>
```

After:
```php
<!-- Use the provider-supported mutable script policy, or self-host a pinned immutable version. -->
```

#### Treat signed URLs as bearer capabilities rather than user identity
- **Do:** Treat signed URLs as bearer capabilities rather than user identity.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a signed URL is assumed to prove the holder is a particular authorized user.
- **Why:** Anyone who obtains the link can present it.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Signature alone is treated as proof of account ownership.
```

After:
```php
Gate::authorize("view", $post); // when identity-based access is required
```

#### Limit shared encrypted environment bundles to intended development or test secrets
- **Do:** Limit shared encrypted environment bundles to intended development or test secrets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a team-sharing bundle inadvertently includes production credentials.
- **Why:** Separate bundles reduce production exposure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Cover actual API paths in CORS configuration
- **Do:** Cover actual API paths in CORS configuration.
- **Flag when:** Flag when CORS path patterns omit an API endpoint that a trusted browser frontend calls.
- **Why:** A correct origin policy has no effect outside its configured paths.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
"paths" => ["api/*"],
```

After:
```php
"paths" => ["api", "api/*", "sanctum/csrf-cookie"],
```

#### Centralize HTML sanitizer configuration behind an application service
- **Do:** Centralize HTML sanitizer configuration behind an application service.
- **Flag when:** Flag when templates or controllers configure independent sanitizers with divergent allowlists.
- **Why:** One service keeps trusted HTML rules consistent.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
(new HtmlSanitizer($localConfig))->sanitize($html);
```

After:
```php
$safeHtml = app(SafeHtml::class)->sanitize($html);
```

#### Name reused authorization predicates clearly
- **Do:** Name reused authorization predicates clearly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a repeated complex permission expression is copied across policies.
- **Why:** Named predicates expose intent and reduce inconsistent changes.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $user->active && $user->team_id === $post->team_id;
```

After:
```php
return $user->isActiveMemberOf($post->team);
```

#### Group OR conditions so tenant and authorization constraints remain effective
- **Do:** Group OR conditions so tenant and authorization constraints remain effective.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an ungrouped orWhere can escape an ownership or tenant predicate.
- **Why:** SQL operator precedence can expose records outside the intended scope.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Post::where("tenant_id", $id)->where("title", $q)->orWhere("body", $q);
```

After:
```php
Post::where("tenant_id", $id)->where(fn ($q) => $q->where("title", $term)->orWhere("body", $term));
```

#### Create real resources in denied-access tests
- **Do:** Create real resources in denied-access tests.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an authorization test passes because route model binding fails before the policy runs.
- **Why:** A missing record can hide an unprotected handler.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$this->actingAs($outsider)->get("/posts/999")->assertNotFound();
```

After:
```php
$post = Post::factory()->create(); $this->actingAs($outsider)->get("/posts/".$post->id)->assertForbidden();
```

#### Assign cache policy and invalidation ownership across edge layers
- **Do:** Assign cache policy and invalidation ownership across edge layers.
- **Flag when:** Flag when multiple edge caches apply conflicting TTLs or no layer owns invalidation.
- **Why:** Unclear ownership produces stale or inconsistently secured responses.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Reject expired JWTs during authentication
- **Do:** Reject expired JWTs during authentication.
- **Flag when:** Flag when JWT verification ignores or disables expiration checks.
- **Why:** A valid signature does not imply a token is still valid.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Decode JWT without checking exp.
```

After:
```php
// Verify signature, issuer/audience and exp using the maintained JWT library.
```

#### Keep confidential data out of signed-only JWT claims
- **Do:** Keep confidential data out of signed-only JWT claims.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a signed JWT payload contains secrets under the assumption it is encrypted.
- **Why:** Signing provides integrity but leaves claims readable.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
["sub" => $user->id, "api_secret" => $secret]
```

After:
```php
["sub" => $user->id]
```

#### Compare authorization identifiers strictly using compatible types
- **Do:** Compare authorization identifiers strictly using compatible types.
- **Flag when:** Flag when ownership checks use loose equality or boolean casts instead of comparing real identifiers.
- **Why:** Coercion can grant access to a different owner.
- **Enforced by:** partial: pint:strict_comparison, partial: larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Comparison\StrictComparisonOfDifferentTypesRule

Before:
```php
return $user->id == (bool) $ownerId;
```

After:
```php
return (string) $user->id === (string) $ownerId;
```

#### Preserve generator key and value contracts when delegating
- **Do:** Preserve generator key and value contracts when delegating.
- **Flag when:** Flag when yield from delegates an iterable with incompatible declared key/value types.
- **Why:** Delegation preserves keys and values rather than converting them.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Generators\YieldFromTypeRule

Before:
```php
/** @return Generator<int, User> */ function users() { yield from $stringKeyed; }
```

After:
```php
/** @return Generator<string, User> */ function users() { yield from $stringKeyed; }
```

#### Document checked exceptions that escape callable boundaries
- **Do:** Document checked exceptions that escape callable boundaries.
- **Flag when:** Flag when functions, methods or property hooks let checked exceptions escape without @throws.
- **Why:** Declared exceptions make error contracts visible to callers and analysis.
- **Enforced by:** larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Exceptions\MissingCheckedExceptionInFunctionThrowsRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Exceptions\MissingCheckedExceptionInMethodThrowsRule, larastan:PHPStan\Rules\Exceptions\MissingCheckedExceptionInPropertyHookThrowsRule

Before:
```php
function save(): void { throw new DomainFailure; }
```

After:
```php
/** @throws DomainFailure */ function save(): void { throw new DomainFailure; }
```

#### State package authorization responsibilities accurately in documentation
- **Do:** State package authorization responsibilities accurately in documentation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when examples imply automatic authorization that the package does not provide.
- **Why:** Users need to know which checks their application must implement.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Define all Filament resource policy abilities or enable strict authorization
- **Do:** Define all Filament resource policy abilities or enable strict authorization.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a protected resource lacks a policy/method and relies on permissive missing-policy behavior.
- **Why:** Resource defaults may allow operations when a policy or method is missing.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Resource has no policy.
```

After:
```php
// Define viewAny/view/create/update/delete and required bulk abilities; enable strict mode to catch omissions.
```

#### Apply mandatory tenant and ownership constraints to the base Filament query
- **Do:** Apply mandatory tenant and ownership constraints to the base Filament query.
- **Flag when:** Flag when visibility depends only on tabs, filters or viewAny rather than a mandatory query constraint.
- **Why:** Client-selected views and resource entry permission do not restrict row visibility.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Tenant filter is optional in the table UI.
```

After:
```php
public static function getEloquentQuery(): Builder { return parent::getEloquentQuery()->whereBelongsTo(auth()->user()); }
```

#### Authorize custom Filament actions and pages explicitly
- **Do:** Authorize custom Filament actions and pages explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when custom pages/actions, attach/detach flows or hidden navigation rely on resource policy coverage they do not inherit.
- **Why:** Custom entry points need their own checked permission boundary.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Action::make("publish")->action(fn ($record) => $record->publish());
```

After:
```php
Action::make("publish")->authorize("publish")->action(fn ($record) => $record->publish());
```

#### Authorize relation-manager owner records explicitly
- **Do:** Authorize relation-manager owner records explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a relation management page checks only the related resource and omits owner tenant/ownership checks.
- **Why:** Access to related models does not establish permission for the owner.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public static function canViewForRecord(Model $owner, string $page): bool { return true; }
```

After:
```php
public static function canViewForRecord(Model $owner, string $page): bool { return auth()->user()->can("view", $owner); }
```

#### Retain Filament authorization unless equivalent checks replace it
- **Do:** Retain Filament authorization unless equivalent checks replace it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a resource sets shouldSkipAuthorization without a complete alternate boundary.
- **Why:** Panel login and tenant scoping do not authorize operations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected static bool $shouldSkipAuthorization = true;
```

After:
```php
protected static bool $shouldSkipAuthorization = false;
```

#### Authorize sensitive work before lifecycle hooks perform it
- **Do:** Authorize sensitive work before lifecycle hooks perform it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when boot/mount/hydrate/placeholder performs sensitive queries or side effects before the applicable authorization hook.
- **Why:** Later access denial cannot undo earlier work or disclosure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function boot() { $this->record->sendToProvider(); }
```

After:
```php
public function boot() { Gate::authorize("send", $this->record); $this->record->sendToProvider(); }
```

#### Customize only the necessary Filament authentication form field
- **Do:** Customize only the necessary Filament authentication form field.
- **Flag when:** Flag when one auth-field change replaces the entire package form definition.
- **Why:** A narrow override preserves package security and compatibility changes.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function form(Schema $schema): Schema { /* copy whole vendor form */ }
```

After:
```php
protected function getPasswordFormComponent(): Component { return parent::getPasswordFormComponent()->autocomplete("current-password"); }
```

#### Scope OTP storage and limits to the full authentication principal
- **Do:** Scope OTP storage and limits to the full authentication principal.
- **Flag when:** Flag when different guards/model classes with the same numeric ID share OTP state or rate budgets.
- **Why:** An ID alone is ambiguous across authentication contexts.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$key = "otp:".$user->id;
```

After:
```php
$key = "otp:".$guard.":".$user::class.":".$user->getKey();
```

#### Bind login OTP challenges to the current session and shared backend
- **Do:** Bind login OTP challenges to the current session and shared backend.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a code issued for one session is accepted from another or multi-server nodes use isolated state.
- **Why:** Session binding and shared state preserve challenge identity across workers.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Cache::put("otp:".$user->id, $hash);
```

After:
```php
Cache::store("redis")->put("otp:".$user->id.":".$sessionId, $hash, $expiry);
```

#### Bind MFA enrollment state to the current scoped principal
- **Do:** Bind MFA enrollment state to the current scoped principal.
- **Flag when:** Flag when encrypted enrollment state can be replayed after the current user changes.
- **Why:** Encryption alone does not bind state to the actor presenting it.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Crypt::decryptString($state); // no owner check
```

After:
```php
abort_unless($statePrincipal === $currentScopedPrincipal, 403);
```

#### Reload security state and reauthorize immediately after step-up authentication
- **Do:** Reload security state and reauthorize immediately after step-up authentication.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a successful MFA challenge resumes a stale authorization decision.
- **Why:** Ownership or permission can change while a challenge is pending.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$pendingOperation->run();
```

After:
```php
$record->refresh(); Gate::authorize("update", $record); $pendingOperation->run();
```

#### Generate, hash, expire and consume OTPs with delivery and verification limits
- **Do:** Generate, hash, expire and consume OTPs with delivery and verification limits.
- **Flag when:** Flag when one-time codes are predictable, stored plaintext, long-lived, reusable or unlimited.
- **Why:** The complete lifecycle is needed for a secure short-code credential.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$code = rand(1000, 9999); Cache::forever($key, $code);
```

After:
```php
// Use CSPRNG codes, hashed storage, short expiry, atomic consumption and both rate limits.
```

#### Authorize operations within the tenant independently of tenant scoping
- **Do:** Authorize operations within the tenant independently of tenant scoping.
- **Flag when:** Flag when tenant-filtered data is considered automatically writable by every tenant member.
- **Why:** Tenant isolation does not define permissions within the tenant.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$post = Post::findOrFail($id); $post->delete();
```

After:
```php
Gate::authorize("delete", $post); $post->delete();
```

#### Validate untrusted values before passing them to trusted Filament configuration APIs
- **Do:** Validate untrusted values before passing them to trusted Filament configuration APIs.
- **Flag when:** Flag when request/model data reaches url/icon/html configuration without the required context checks.
- **Why:** Configuration methods often trust their arguments.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextColumn::make("link")->url($untrustedUrl);
```

After:
```php
TextColumn::make("link")->url(Str::sanitizeUrl($validatedUrl));
```

#### Avoid deferred page authorization gaps from lazy loading
- **Do:** Avoid deferred page authorization gaps from lazy loading.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a Filament page depends on mount-time authorization while lazy loading exposes its pre-mount path.
- **Why:** Checks must run before protected work and output.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Lazy page assumes mount has already authorized it.
```

After:
```php
// Disable lazy loading or independently authorize every pre-mount path.
```

#### Authorize Filament inline editable columns explicitly
- **Do:** Authorize Filament inline editable columns explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when editable columns rely on resource policies they do not call.
- **Why:** Inline writes have a separate permission path.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
ToggleColumn::make("active")
```

After:
```php
ToggleColumn::make("active")->disabled(fn ($record) => auth()->user()->cannot("update", $record))
```

#### Validate URL hosts and network destinations beyond scheme sanitization
- **Do:** Validate URL hosts and network destinations beyond scheme sanitization.
- **Flag when:** Flag when scheme-clean URLs can still redirect to untrusted hosts or reach private services.
- **Why:** Scheme allowlists do not prevent open redirects or SSRF.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$url = Str::sanitizeUrl($input); Http::get($url);
```

After:
```php
$url = $destinationPolicy->validatePublicAllowedHost($input); Http::get($url);
```

#### Tighten rich-HTML sanitizer capabilities for untrusted authors
- **Do:** Tighten rich-HTML sanitizer capabilities for untrusted authors.
- **Flag when:** Flag when untrusted rich text retains risky inline styles or attributes beyond the app need.
- **Why:** Allowed CSS can still overlay UI or cause external resource requests.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Use a broad editor allowlist for public comments.
```

After:
```php
// Drop style attributes and unnecessary elements in HtmlSanitizerConfig for untrusted authors.
```

#### Validate and authorize URL-opened action arguments
- **Do:** Validate and authorize URL-opened action arguments.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Filament actionArguments/actionContext values are trusted because the action was opened from a generated link.
- **Why:** Clients can change URL arguments directly.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Action::make("run")->action(fn ($arguments) => $service->run($arguments));
```

After:
```php
// Validate arguments and authorize the referenced resource inside action().
```

#### Rate limit sensitive or expensive Filament actions
- **Do:** Rate limit sensitive or expensive Filament actions.
- **Flag when:** Flag when repeat submissions can abuse an unbounded action.
- **Why:** Action-level limits cover Livewire-triggered operations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Action::make("send")->action($send)
```

After:
```php
Action::make("send")->rateLimit(5)->action($send)
```

#### Perform confirmed navigation from the action handler
- **Do:** Perform confirmed navigation from the action handler.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a url() action is assumed to show a confirmation modal.
- **Why:** URL actions navigate directly and do not execute a confirmation workflow.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Action::make("leave")->url($url)->requiresConfirmation()
```

After:
```php
Action::make("leave")->requiresConfirmation()->action(fn () => redirect($url))
```

#### Restrict import and export downloads to their creator or an explicit authorized role
- **Do:** Restrict import and export downloads to their creator or an explicit authorized role.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a custom ImportPolicy/ExportPolicy omits the creator check and exposes generated files to other users.
- **Why:** Failure CSVs and exports can contain private data.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function view(User $user, Export $export): bool { return true; }
```

After:
```php
public function view(User $user, Export $export): bool { return $export->user()->is($user); }
```

#### Authorize each imported row before creating or updating it
- **Do:** Authorize each imported row before creating or updating it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when untrusted imports bypass resource policies and mutate records without row checks.
- **Why:** Permission to upload a file does not authorize every row operation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
protected function beforeUpdate(): void {}
```

After:
```php
protected function beforeUpdate(): void { Gate::authorize("update", $this->record); }
```

#### Apply mandatory visibility constraints to export queries
- **Do:** Apply mandatory visibility constraints to export queries.
- **Flag when:** Flag when exports include rows hidden by per-record visibility rules because model policies are not called.
- **Why:** An export must preserve the same data-access boundary as browsing.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
ExportAction::make()
```

After:
```php
ExportAction::make()->modifyQueryUsing(fn ($q) => $q->whereBelongsTo(auth()->user()))
```

#### Do not rely on disabled or read-only fields for secrecy or authorization
- **Do:** Do not rely on disabled or read-only fields for secrecy or authorization.
- **Flag when:** Flag when sensitive values are sent to a client because the field cannot be edited.
- **Why:** Read-only UI state remains inspectable and does not establish permission.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make("api_secret")->disabled()
```

After:
```php
// Omit the secret from unauthorized responses and enforce changes on the server.
```

#### Exclude presentational form fields from persisted state
- **Do:** Exclude presentational form fields from persisted state.
- **Flag when:** Flag when confirmation/helper fields are saved to a model.
- **Why:** Presentation-only state does not belong in persistence.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make("password_confirmation")
```

After:
```php
TextInput::make("password_confirmation")->saved(false)
```

#### Save password edits only when a new password is supplied
- **Do:** Save password edits only when a new password is supplied.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an empty edit form overwrites an existing password or requires unnecessary changes.
- **Why:** Blank edit fields should preserve the current credential.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TextInput::make("password")->password()->required()
```

After:
```php
TextInput::make("password")->password()->saved(fn (?string $state) => filled($state))->required(fn (string $operation) => $operation === "create")
```

#### Authorize exact trusted upload paths after canonicalization
- **Do:** Authorize exact trusted upload paths after canonicalization.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a directory-prefix allow check admits paths containing parent traversal segments.
- **Why:** Path normalization after prefix checks can escape the allowed directory.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return str_starts_with($path, "uploads/");
```

After:
```php
return in_array($canonicalPath, $trustedPaths, strict: true);
```

#### Do not bypass Filament sanitization with untrusted HtmlString or view output
- **Do:** Do not bypass Filament sanitization with untrusted HtmlString or view output.
- **Flag when:** Flag when formatStateUsing returns trusted HTML wrappers containing untrusted state.
- **Why:** Trusted wrappers skip the normal html() sanitizer.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->formatStateUsing(fn ($state) => new HtmlString($state))
```

After:
```php
->html() // Pass ordinary untrusted strings through the component sanitizer.
```

#### Report partial bulk-action authorization outcomes clearly
- **Do:** Report partial bulk-action authorization outcomes clearly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a mixed allowed/denied bulk selection reports all records succeeded.
- **Why:** Accurate counts prevent users assuming denied records changed.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
->successNotificationTitle("All records deleted")
```

After:
```php
->successNotificationTitle(fn ($successCount) => "Deleted {$successCount} records")
```

#### Scope external/custom table data before sorting, pagination and selection resolution
- **Do:** Scope external/custom table data before sorting, pagination and selection resolution.
- **Flag when:** Flag when records()/resolveSelectedRecordsUsing trusts client keys or UI filters to restrict access.
- **Why:** Custom data sources do not inherit Eloquent policy or tenant scoping.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
return $api->findMany($keys);
```

After:
```php
return $api->findMany($keys, tenant: $authorizedTenant); // authorize each selected operation
```

#### Authorize user operations independently of an upstream service credential
- **Do:** Authorize user operations independently of an upstream service credential.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a privileged API key is treated as proof the current user may invoke every upstream operation.
- **Why:** Service credentials usually grant broader access than an individual actor.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$api->delete($arguments["id"]);
```

After:
```php
Gate::authorize("delete", $record); $api->delete($record->external_id);
```

#### Check permissions before confirmation workflows load or mutate data
- **Do:** Check permissions before confirmation workflows load or mutate data.
- **Flag when:** Flag when confirmation modals or valid modal input are used as the only authorization boundary.
- **Why:** Confirmation establishes intent rather than permission.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Action::make("delete")->requiresConfirmation()->action($delete)
```

After:
```php
Action::make("delete")->authorize("delete")->requiresConfirmation()->action($delete)
```

#### Authorize Filament widget visibility with canView
- **Do:** Authorize Filament widget visibility with canView.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a protected widget renders or loads data without its required canView decision.
- **Why:** The widget boundary must run before sensitive work.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public static function canView(): bool { return true; }
```

After:
```php
public static function canView(): bool { return auth()->user()->can("viewMetrics"); }
```

#### Restrict viewing sensitive settings as well as editing them
- **Do:** Restrict viewing sensitive settings as well as editing them.
- **Flag when:** Flag when canEdit denies writes but unauthorized users can read API keys or internal flags.
- **Why:** Write permission does not protect disclosure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function canEdit(): bool { return false; }
```

After:
```php
public static function canAccess(): bool { return auth()->user()->can("viewSensitiveSettings"); }
```

#### Authorize tag management on the server and reflect it in the UI
- **Do:** Authorize tag management on the server and reflect it in the UI.
- **Flag when:** Flag when tag editing is only hidden client-side or omitted from the permission model.
- **Why:** Tags can be meaningful record mutations.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
TagsInput::make("tags")
```

After:
```php
TagsInput::make("tags")->disabled(fn () => auth()->user()->cannot("manageTags", $record)) // plus server action check
```

#### Encrypt Inertia history for sensitive pages
- **Do:** Encrypt Inertia history for sensitive pages.
- **Flag when:** Flag when sensitive page props remain readable from stored browser history after logout.
- **Why:** History encryption limits retained client-side disclosure.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// Sensitive page uses default unencrypted history.
```

After:
```php
Inertia::encryptHistory();
```

#### Pass the active CSP nonce to Ziggy inline routes output
- **Do:** Pass the active CSP nonce to Ziggy inline routes output.
- **Flag when:** Flag when @routes inline scripts are blocked and CSP is weakened to allow them.
- **Why:** The matching nonce permits the script without broad unsafe-inline.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
@routes
```

After:
```php
@routes(nonce: $nonce)
```

#### Keep Laravel Actions business logic in handle and delegate transport adapters to it
- **Do:** Keep Laravel Actions business logic in handle and delegate transport adapters to it.
- **Flag when:** Flag when asController/asJob/asCommand embeds divergent business implementations.
- **Why:** Adapters should translate execution context around one application operation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function asController() { /* duplicated operation */ }
```

After:
```php
public function asController(ActionRequest $request) { return $this->handle($request->validated()); }
```

#### Keep Xdebug off by default and enable required modes explicitly
- **Do:** Keep Xdebug off by default and enable required modes explicitly.
- **Flag when:** Flag when development containers always enable expensive debugging modes.
- **Why:** Explicit modes avoid unnecessary runtime overhead.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### URL-encode credentials embedded in connection URIs
- **Do:** URL-encode credentials embedded in connection URIs.
- **Flag when:** Flag when special characters in raw usernames/passwords alter the URI structure.
- **Why:** Encoding preserves credential boundaries.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
$uri = "mongodb://{$user}:{$password}@host/db";
```

After:
```php
$uri = "mongodb://".rawurlencode($user).":".rawurlencode($password)."@host/db";
```

#### Target contributions at supported release branches
- **Do:** Target contributions at supported release branches.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a fix is submitted to an unsupported branch contrary to the project contribution policy.
- **Why:** Supported branches are the maintained release targets.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Document supported security-fix versions in SECURITY.md
- **Do:** Document supported security-fix versions in SECURITY.md.
- **Flag when:** Flag when package users cannot determine which releases receive security fixes.
- **Why:** A support policy guides safe upgrades and private reporting.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Change Livewire release tokens for deployments incompatible with existing snapshots
- **Do:** Change Livewire release tokens for deployments incompatible with existing snapshots.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a breaking component deployment accepts stale browser snapshots without refresh handling.
- **Why:** Release tokens can prompt stale sessions to reload.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Clean up navigation-persistent global event listeners
- **Do:** Clean up navigation-persistent global event listeners.
- **Flag when:** Flag when each component/navigation registers another global listener without removal.
- **Why:** Persistent listeners otherwise accumulate and repeat side effects.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
document.addEventListener("event", handler);
```

After:
```php
document.addEventListener("event", handler, {once: true}); // or remove on destroy
```

#### Load navigation transition styles from shared assets
- **Do:** Load navigation transition styles from shared assets.
- **Flag when:** Flag when transition CSS exists only on one side of a navigation.
- **Why:** Both old and new views need the transition definitions.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<!-- Page-only transition style block. -->
```

After:
```php
@vite(["resources/css/app.css"])
```

#### Configure analytics for client-side navigation
- **Do:** Configure the installed analytics provider to record Livewire client-side navigations. Fathom supports data-spa="auto"; use other providers' documented automatic tracking or a page-view callback on livewire:navigated.
- **Flag when:** Flag analytics recording only the initial document load, or assuming the Fathom data-spa attribute works for every analytics script.
- **Why:** SPA-aware tracking records actual navigation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<script src="/analytics.js"></script>
```

After:
```php
<script src="https://cdn.usefathom.com/script.js" data-site="YOUR_SITE_ID" data-spa="auto" defer></script>
```

#### Initialize page scripts on the navigation lifecycle event
- **Do:** Initialize page scripts on the navigation lifecycle event.
- **Flag when:** Flag when page initialization depends only on DOMContentLoaded despite client-side navigation.
- **Why:** DOMContentLoaded does not recur on later visits.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
```

After:
```php
document.addEventListener("livewire:navigated", init);
```

#### Track versioned head assets so navigation reloads after deployment changes
- **Do:** Track versioned head assets so navigation reloads after deployment changes.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Livewire navigation keeps stale assets because tags lack tracking or use an undetected version change.
- **Why:** Tracked version changes trigger a full reload.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
<script src="/app.js"></script>
```

After:
```php
<script src="/app.js?id=BUILD_HASH" data-navigate-track></script>
```

#### Use nonce-based CSP without unsafe-eval for compatible applications
- **Do:** Use nonce-based CSP without unsafe-eval for compatible applications.
- **Flag when:** Flag when the application enables unsafe-eval or broad inline execution despite supporting nonce-based scripts.
- **Why:** A restrictive execution policy reduces injected script capability.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Validate and authorize client-supplied property changes before using them
- **Do:** Validate and authorize client-supplied property changes before using them.
- **Flag when:** Flag when an updated Livewire property immediately drives privileged behavior without checks.
- **Why:** Update hooks are still untrusted request boundaries.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
public function updatedRole() { $this->user->role = $this->role; }
```

After:
```php
public function updatingRole($value) { Gate::authorize("changeRole", $this->user); validator(["role" => $value], $rules)->validate(); }
```

#### Preserve the supplied hashed Livewire route path during customization
- **Do:** Preserve the supplied hashed Livewire route path during customization.
- **Flag when:** Flag when setUpdateRoute/setScriptRoute discards the provided path and removes the unique endpoint component.
- **Why:** Custom routing should retain the installed-version endpoint identity.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
Livewire::setUpdateRoute(fn ($handle, $path) => Route::post("/update", $handle));
```

After:
```php
// Prefix the supplied $path rather than replacing it.
```

#### Route and protect the current Livewire hashed endpoint prefix at the edge
- **Do:** Route and protect the current Livewire hashed endpoint prefix at the edge.
- **Flag when:** Flag when Nginx/CDN/firewall rules still match only legacy /livewire/ paths.
- **Why:** The hashed prefix must reach Laravel and retain intended edge protection.
- **Enforced by:** manual

#### Preserve and review customized policies during Shield generation
- **Do:** Preserve and review customized policies during Shield generation.
- **Flag when:** Flag when shield:generate overwrites manually edited policies or regenerates unrelated policies blindly.
- **Why:** Generated defaults can remove application access rules.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
php artisan shield:generate --all
```

After:
```php
php artisan shield:generate --resource=Post --option=policies --ignore-existing-policies
```

#### Keep Shield common and resource-specific policy method sets separate
- **Do:** Keep Shield common and resource-specific policy method sets separate.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a resource-specific ability is generated for every resource through policies.methods.
- **Why:** Correct method scope prevents accidental permission expansion.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
"policies" => ["methods" => ["view", "publish"]],
```

After:
```php
// Keep common methods global; put publish under the relevant resources.manage entry.
```

#### Declare user-only Shield methods as single-parameter abilities
- **Do:** Declare user-only Shield methods as single-parameter abilities.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a generated user-only ability receives an unintended model argument.
- **Why:** Signatures must match Laravel ability invocation.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// publishDashboard absent from single_parameter_methods.
```

After:
```php
"single_parameter_methods" => ["viewAny", "create", "publishDashboard"],
```

#### Implement per-panel policy selection through explicit gate logic
- **Do:** Implement per-panel policy selection through explicit gate logic.
- **Flag when:** Flag when a conditioned enforcePolicies callback is assumed to swap policies per panel.
- **Why:** The condition controls enforcement, not policy mapping.
- **Enforced by:** manual

Before:
```php
// enforcePolicies(fn () => $panel === "admin") assumed to select alternate policy.
```

After:
